sa ātaraṃ varuṇamagra ā vavṛtsva devā~ acchā sumatī yajñavanasaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ yajñavanasam |

taṃ devaṃ yajñavanasaṃ yajñarjanayajñairhavirbhiḥ saṃbhajanīyaṃ yajñavanasaṃ ca yajñasya saṃbhaktāraṃ jyeṣṭham atiśayena praśasyam ṛtāvānam apāṃ svāmitayodakavantaṃ satyavantaṃ vā ādityam aditaḥ putraṃ carṣaṇīdhṛtaṃ manuṣyāṇāmudakapradānena dhārakaṃ sumatī śobhanabuddhyā hetunā carṣaṇīdhṛtaṃ carṣaṇibhivirddharddhṛtaṃ rājānaṃ rājantam etādṛśaṃ varuṇa devān devanaśīlān stotṛn accha abhi ā vavṛtsva āvartaya abhisukhīkuru ||

ᵛdasma darśanīya he agne ᵛasmabhyaṃ ᵛśaṃ ᵛkṛdhi sukhaṃ kuru |
‘ tvaṃ no agne ’ ityetadārabhyedaṃ sūktamuttarāṇi sūktāni ca prātaranuvāke āgneye ṛtau traiṣṭubhe chandasyābhinaśastre ca viniyuktāni |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘ tvaṃ no agne varuṇasya vidvānityetatprabhṛtīni catvāri ’ (āśva. śrau. 4. 13) iti |
tatra ‘ tvaṃ no agne ’ iti dve yājyānuvākye |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘ agnīvaruṇau sviṣṭakṛdarthe tvaṃ no agne varuṇasya vidvāniti dve ’ (āśva. śrau. 6. 13) iti |
‘ tadāhurya āhitāgniḥ ’ ityupakramyāmnātaṃ—‘ tasya yājyānuvākye tvaṃ no agne varuṇasya vidvānstvaṃ no agne'vamo bhavatī ’ (ai. ā. 7. 9) iti ||
tvaṃ noṃ agne varuṇasya vidvānde॒vasya̭ he॒ḻo'va̭ yāsisīṣṭhāḥ |
yaji̭ṣṭho va॒hni̭tama॒ḥ śośṷcāno॒ viśvā॒ dveṣā̭ṃsi॒ pra mṷmugdhya॒smat ||

he agne saḥ tādṛśaḥ tvam ūtī ūtyā rakṣaṇena naḥ asmākam avamaḥ arvācīnaḥ pratyāsannaḥ san asyā upaso vyuṣṭau vyucchane prātaḥkāle'gnihotrādikarmasiddhayarthaṃ nediṣṭhaḥ bhava atiśayenāsmadantikastho bhava |

sa jāyata prathamaḥ pustāsu maho bubhe rajaso asya yonau | apādaśīrṣā guhamāno antāyoryuvāno vṛṣabhasya nīḻe || 11 || saḥ | jāyata | prathamaḥ | pustāsu | mahaḥ | bubhe | rajasaḥ | asya | yonau | apāt | aśīrṣā | guhamānaḥ | antā | ayoryuvānaḥ | vṛṣabhasya | nīḻe || 11 ||
vsaḥ agniḥ vprathamaḥ āhavanīyādirūpatayā śreṣṭhaḥ san vpaśyāsu yajamānānāṃ gṛheṣu vjāyata āhutyadhikaraṇatayā saṃpadyate |
tathā vmahaḥ mahataḥ vasya vrajasaḥ antarikṣasya vbudhne mūle pṛthivyāṃ tatrāpi vyonau uttaravedyādisthāne saṃpadyate |
vvṛṣabhasya varṣaṇasamarthasya meghasya vnīle nilaye nabhasi vāyoyuvānaḥ dhūmākāreṇātmānamāyojayan vartate |
yaḥ prathamo vaidyuto'gniḥ paśyāsu nadīṣu vbudhne'ntarikṣe maho mahato rajasa udakramya tejaso vā yonau sthāne ca carati |

apādaśīrṣā pādaśirovarjitaḥ antā ātmanaḥ paryantapradeśān svatejasā gṛhamāna ācchādayan punaśca āyoyuvānaḥ tāni tejāṃsi svātmani miśrīkurvan vṛṣabhasya meghasya2 nīle sthāne nabhasi carati so'gniradhunā karmayogatayā ajāyata |
pra śardha ārta prathamaṃ vipanyā ṛtasya yonā vṛṣabhasya nīḻe |
spārho yuvā vapuṣyo vibhāvā sapta priyāso'janayanta vṛṣṇe |

ṛtaṃ voce narmasā pṛcchyamānastavāśasā jātavedo yadīdam |
tvamasya kṣayasi yaddu viśvai divi yadu draviṇaṃ yatpṛthivyām ||
ṛtam | voce | narmasā | pṛcchyamānaḥ | tava | ā'śasā | jāta'vedaḥ | yadi | idam | tvam | asya | kṣayasi | yat | du | viśvai | divi | yat | ū~ iti | draviṇam | yat | pṛthivyām || 11 ||
ahaṃ yajamānaḥ ^namasā namaskāreṇa saha ^pṛcchyamānaḥ anyairanuyujyamānaḥ san ^ṛtaṃ ^voce satyaṃ bravīmi |
he ^jātavedaḥ jātānāṃ veditarjātaprajña vā agne ^tavāśasā svastutyā sādhanena ^yadīdaṃ dhanaṃ labdhamasmābhiḥ syāt ^asya dhanasya ^tvaṃ ^kṣayasi tvameveśvaro bhavasi |
^divi dyuloke ^yadu ^draviṇaṃ yadeva dhanaṃ ^yat ca ^pṛthivyāṃ dhanaṃ tasya sarvasya tvamīśvaro bhavasi |
kiṃ naṷ a॒sya dravi̭ṇa॒ṃ kadra॒tnaṃ vi naṷ voco jātavedaścikitvān |
guhā̭dhvanaḥ para॒maṃ yatpa̭ro a॒sya reku॒ pada॒ṃ na ni॒dānā̭ a॒ganma ||

kim | naḥ | a॒sya | dravi̭ṇam | kat | ha | ra॒tnam | vi | naḥ | vocaḥ | jāta̭'vedaḥ | ci॒ki॒tvān | guhā̭ | a॒dhvanaḥ | pa॒ra॒mam | yat | naḥ | a॒sya | rekṷ | pa॒dam | na | ni॒dānā̭ | a॒ganma || 12 ||
pūrvamantreṇa yasya̭ dhanasya̭ a॒sminsvāmi॒tvamṷktam asya dhanasya̭ kiṃ draviṇaṃ kiṃ sādhanabhūtaṃ naḥ asmabhya̭ṃ dātavyaṃ dhanamasti |
kadra ratnaṃ kiṃ ca ramaṇīyaṃ hitakaraṃ dhanamasti |
tadvanaṃ he jātavedaḥ jātadhanāgne cikitsān cetanāvānbhijñastvaṃ naḥ asmabhyaṃ vi vocaḥ vibrūhi |
asya adhvanaḥ dhanaprāpti-mārgasya yat guhā guhāyāṃ nihitaṃ guhaṃ paramam utkṛṣṭaṃ prāptavyamasti tadapi naḥ asmabhyaṃ vivocaḥ |
vayaṃ reku riktaṃ padaṃ gantavyaṃ sthānaṃ gṛhādikaṃ nidānā anyairnindyamānāḥ ||
kā ma॒ryādā̭ va॒yunā̭ kadra॒ vāma̭ccha॒ gamḙma ra॒ghavo॒ na vā॒jam |
kadā̭ naṷ de॒vīrmṛ̭tasya patna॒ḥ sūro̭ va॒rṇana॒ tata̭nu॒ṣārḥ ||
kā | ma॒ryādā̭ | va॒yunā̭ | kat | ha | vā॒mam | a॒ccha | gamḙma | ra॒ghvaḥ | na | vā॒jam | kadā̭ | naḥ | de॒vīḥ | a॒mṛta̭sya | patnī̭ḥ | sūro̭ | va॒rṇana | tata̭nu॒ṣārḥ | u॒ṣasa̭ḥ || 13 ||
kā maryādā kā prītyādivyavasthā kā ca vayunā prajñānaṃ padārthaviṣayaṃ kadra kiṃ ca vāmaṃ vananīyaṃ padārthajātam |
kadā kasmin kāle naḥ asmākaṃ vyavahārāya devīḥ devyo dyotamānāḥ amṛtasya amaradharmasyādityasya patnīḥ patnyaḥ pālayiṣyaḥ sūraḥ prasaviṣyaḥ uṣāsaḥ uṣasaḥ varṇana prakāśena tatanu vistārayeyuḥ |
evaṃ sūryasambandhana uṣasaḥ stutyā sarvātmano vaiśvānarasya stutiravagantavyā ||
a॒dhā tḙ a॒gne kimi̭ha va॒danta̭nāyu॒dhāsa̭ ā॒satā̭ sa॒cantām ||
a॒nirḙṇa | va॒rcasā̭ | phu॒lvena̭ | pra॒tītyḙna | ku॒dhunā̭ | a॒ta॒pāsa̭ḥ | a॒dha | tḙ | a॒gne | kim | i॒ha | va॒danti̭ | a॒nāyṷdhāsaḥ | a॒satā̭ | sa॒cantām || 14 ||
kṛdhivati hasvanāma ' kṛdhuko vamrakaḥ ' ( ni. 2. 2. 6 ) iti tannāmasūttvāt |
evaṃvidhena ^vacasā ^anupāsaḥ anusā janāḥ ^adha adhunā ^iha asmin loke he ^agne ^te tvāṃ ^kiṃ ^vadanti |
asya śriye samidhānasya vṛṣṇo va soranīkaṃ dama ā ruroca |
ruśadvāsaḥ sudṛśīkarūpaḥ kṣitirna rāyā puruvāro adyaut ||
asya | śriye | sam'idhānasya | vṛṣṇaḥ | vasoḥ | anīkam | dame | ā | ruroca | ruśat | vasānaḥ | sudṛśīkarūpaḥ | kṣitiḥ | na | rāyā | puru'vāraḥ | adyaut || 15 ||
^vṛṣṇaḥ varṣituḥ phalasya ^vasoḥ^ vāsayituḥ ^asya agneḥ ^anīkaṃ tejaḥsaṃghaḥ ^dame yāgagṛhe ^ā ^ruroca sarvato dīpyate |
dīsaṃ tejaḥ ^vasānaḥ ācchādayan ata eva ^sudṛśīkarūpaḥ suṣṭhu darśanīyarūpaḥ ^puruvāraḥ bahubhiḥ ṛtvigbhiryajamānaiḥ^ varaṇīyaḥ san ^adyaut dyotate |
‘ ūrdhva ū pu ṇaḥ ’ ityekādaśacaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ sūktaṃ vāmadevasyārṣaṃ traiṣṭubhamāgneyam |
sūtritaṃ ca--‘ ūrdhva ū pu ṇaḥ sasasya yahiyuteti pañca ’ ( āśva. śrau. 4. 13 ) iti ||
ūrdhva ū ṣu ṇo adhvarasya hotarge tiṣṭha devatātā yajīyān |
tvaṃ hi viśvamabhyasi manma pra vedhasaścittarasi manīṣām ||
ūrdhvaḥ | ū~ iti | su | naḥ | adhvarasya | hotaḥ | agne | tiṣṭha | deva'tātā | yajīyān | tvam | hi | viśvam | abhi | asi | manma | pra | vedhasaḥ | cit | tirasi | manīṣām || 1 ||
he homaniṣpādaka ^agne ^yajīyān yaṣṭatamastvaṃ ^naḥ asmākam ^ūrdhva ^ū ^ṣu ^tiṣṭha unnata eva tiṣṭha |
^tvaṃ ^hi ^tvaṃ khalu ^viśvaṃ sarvaṃ ^manma mananīyaṃ śatrūṇāṃ dhanam ^amyasi abhibhavasi |
5. ca-pha-yajñe manma mananīyatvaṃ vedhaso brahmaṇo viśvamabhi ami hi khalu |

amūroṃ hotā nyasādi viśvarbhirmandro vidatheṣu pracetāḥ | ūrdhvaṃ bhānuṃ savitevāśrinetaiva dhūmaṃ stabhāyaduṣa dyām || 2 || amūraḥ | hotā | ni | asādi | viśva | agniḥ | mandraḥ | vidatheṣu | pra'cetāḥ | ūrdhvam | bhānum | savitā'iva | aśret | metā'iva | dhūmam | stabhāyat | upa | dyām || 2 ||
^hotā homaniṣpādakaḥ ^mandraḥ madanīyaḥ ^mādayitā vā ^pracetāḥ prakṛṣṭajñānaḥ ^agniḥ devaḥ ^viśva ṛtvigpāsu ^prajāsu madhye ^vidatheṣu yāgeṣu nimittabhūteṣu ^nyasādi nitarāṃ sthāpitaḥ |
atha tathābhūto'gniḥ ^bhānuṃ dīptiṃ ^saviteva uditaḥ sūrya iva ^ūrdhvam ^aśret ūrdhvamukhamāśrayati |
sā yathā svādhiṣṭhitaṃ ^vaṃśādikaṃ stabhnāti tadvadayamagniḥ ^dhūmaṃ svosthitaṃ ^dyām ^upa dyulokasyopari ^stabhāyat stabhnāti ||

yatā sujurṇī rātanīṃ ghṛtācīṃ pradakṣiṇedevatātimurāṇaḥ | udu svarurvajā nākraḥ paśvo anakti sudhitaḥ sumekaḥ || 3 || yatā | su'jurṇiḥ | rātanīṃ | ghṛtācīṃ | pra'dakṣiṇita | deva'tātim | urāṇaḥ | ut | ū~ iti | svaruḥ | nava'jāḥ | na | akraḥ | paśvaḥ | anakti | sudhitaḥ | su'mekaḥ || 3 ||
^yatā saṃyatā ^sujurṇiḥ śobhanajavā suṣṭhu jīrṇā purāṇī vā ^ghṛtācī |
^devatātiṃ yajñaṃ tathā ^urāṇaḥ uru kurvāṇo'dhvaryurbhirvāṃ ^pradakṣiṇit pradakṣiṇametīti pradakṣiṇit |
‘ capālavantaḥ svaravaḥ pṛthivyām ’ ( ṛ. saṃ. 3. 8. 10 ) ityādiṣu svaruśabdena yūpāmidhānācca |
sudhitaḥ svarureva udu utkṛṣṭaḥ paśvaḥ paśvanakti |

stīrṇe barhiṣi samidhāne agnā ūrdhvo adhvaryurjujuṣāṇo asthāt | paryubhiḥ paśupā na hotā triviṣṭyaiti pradivaṃ urāṇaḥ || 4 || stīrṇe | barhiṣi | sam'idhāne | agnau | ūrdhvaḥ | adhvaryuḥ | jujuṣāṇaḥ | asthāt | pari | agniḥ | paśu'pāḥ | na | hotā | tri'viṣṭyai | eti | pra'divaṃ | urāṇaḥ || 4 ||
vbarhiṣi vedyāṃ vstīrṇe āstṛte sati vagnau āhavanīyādike vsamidhāne samyagdhidhyamāne ca mati vadhvaryuḥ adhvarasya netā vjujuṣāṇaḥ devān prīṇayan vūrdhvaḥ vasthāt tiṣṭhati |
purātanaḥ vurāṇaḥ svalpamapi havirdevayogyatvasaṃpādanane uru kurvāṇaḥ |
‘ yadvai devairjanyate havistadvirimātraṃ vardhate ’ iti śruteḥ agnerurvīkaraṇamucitam |
īdṛśaḥ vagniḥ vpaśupā vna paśūnāṃ pālaka iva paśūn vtriviṣṭa trirāvṛtya vpari vṇati |
pari tmanā mitadṷreti hotā̭gnirmandro madhṷvacā ṛtāvā̭ |
drava̭ntyasya vā॒jino॒ na śokā॒ bhaya̭nte॒ viśvā॒ bhuva̭nā yada॒bhrāṭ ||
pari̭ | tmanā̭ | mi॒ta'dṷḥ | e॒ti | hotā̭ | a॒gniḥ | ma॒ndraḥ | madhṷ'vacāḥ | ṛta'vā̭ | drava̭nti | a॒sya | vā॒jina̭ḥ | na | śokā̭ḥ | bhaya̭nte | viśvā̭ | bhuva̭nā | yat | a॒bhrāṭ || 5 ||
ayaṃ vhotā homaniṣpādakaḥ vagniḥ vdharmā ātmanā svarūpeṇaiva vmitaduḥ parimitagatiḥ san vpari veti parito gacchati paśum |
vmandraḥ mādanīyo modayitā vā vmadhuvacāḥ madhuravacanaḥ 2 vṛtāvā yajñavān |
vvājinaḥ haviṣmataḥ vasya agneḥ vśokāḥ vna dīptayo'pi |
vājino na aśvā iva dravantīti yojyam |
vyat yasmāt ayam vabhrāṭ ājate tasmāt vviśvā vbhuvanā sarvāṇi bhūtajātāni4 vbhayante bhītāni bhavanti ||
bhadrā̭ te a॒gne sva॒nīka॒ saṃha̭gghorasya sa॒to vi॒ṣuṇa̭sya cā॒ruḥ |
na yattḙ śoci̭stama̭sā॒ vara̭nta॒ na dhva॒smāna̭sta॒nvī̭ re॒pa ā dhuḥ ||

bhadrā̭ | te | a॒gne | su॒'a॒nīka॒ | sam'ha̭k | gho॒rasya̭ | sa॒taḥ | vi॒ṣuṇa̭sya | cā॒ruḥ | na | yat | te | śoci̭ḥ | ta॒masā̭ | vara̭nta | na | dhva॒smāna̭ḥ | ta॒nvī̭ | re॒paḥ | ā | dhuḥ | iti dhuḥ || 6 ||
he vsvanīka śobhanajvāla vagne vghorasya bhītijanakasyāpi vsataḥ vviṣuṇasya viśvak sarvato vyāsasya vte tava vcāruḥ ramaṇīyā vbhadrā stutyā kalyāṇī vā mūrtiḥ vsaṃhak saṃdṛṣṭiḥ |
vyat yasmāt vte vśociḥ dīptiḥ vtamasā andhakāreṇa vna vvaranta na vārayanti niśāḥ |
yasmācca vdhvasmānaḥ dhvaṃsakā rākṣasādayaḥ te vtanvi tava śarīre vrepaḥ pāpaṃ dhvaṃsanādirūpaṃ vna vā vdhuḥ na dadhati |
1. kha-ga-ca-ṇa-bha-pradivaḥ urāṇaḥ ururvāṇo'dhvaryurnāmaitat | 2. kha-ga-ca-ṇa-na-pa-pha-bha-sa- madhuvacanaḥ | 3. ta-upamārthakaḥ | 4. kha-ga-ca-ṇa-bhūtāni |

na yasya sāturjanitoravāri na mātāpitarā nū ciṃdiṣṭai | adhā mitro na sudhitaḥ pāvako'gnidīdāya mānuṣīṣu viśvu || 7 || na | yasya | sātuḥ | janitoḥ | abāri | na | mātāpitarā | nu | cit | iṣṭai | adha | mitraḥ | na | sudhitaḥ | pāvakaḥ | agniḥ | dīdāya | mānuṣīṣu | viśvu || 7 ||
^janitoḥ janayiturvyutpādakasya ^yasya vaiśvānarasya ^sātuḥ saniḥ paścādilakṣaṇaṃ dānaṃ dīptirvā ^na ^avāri kenāpi na vāryate |
kiṃca ^mātāpitarā mātāpitarau dyāvāpṛthivyau yamya ^iṣṭau preṣaṇe ^nu ^cit kṣiprameva ^na prabhavataḥ |
^adha ^api ca ^mitro ^na sakheva ^sudhitaḥ sutrasaḥ ^pāvakaḥ śodhakaḥ ^agniḥ ^mānuṣīṣu manaḥ sambandhinīṣu ^viśvu prajāsu ^dīdāya dīpyate ||
balātiśayātsāpuṭādisthānebhya udakaṃ kṣarantaḥ Vrohitāsaḥ rohitā lohitavarṇāḥ Vṛjvañcaḥ |
Vsvañcaḥ suṣṭhu gacchantaḥ Varupāsaḥ ārocamānāḥ Vvṛṣaṇaḥ yuvāno varṣitāraḥ? vā ||
' vā ṣapūrvasya nigame ' iti vikalpena dīrghavidhānādatra dīrghobhāvaḥ ||
ye ha tye te sahamānā ayāsastveṣāso agne arcayaścaranti |
śyenāso na duvasanāso arthaṃ tuviṣvaṇaso mārutaṃ na śardhaḥ ||
ye | ha | tye | te | sahamānāḥ | ayāsaḥ | tveṣāsaḥ | agne | arcayaḥ | caranti | śyenāsaḥ | na | duvasanāsaḥ | artham | tuvi'svanasaḥ | mārutam | na | śardhaḥ || 10 ||
he Vagne Vye Vha khalu Vtye te prasiddhāḥ Vsahamānāḥ śatrūnabhibhavantaḥ Vayāsaḥ gamanaśīlāḥ Vtveṣāsaḥ dīptāḥ Vduvasanāsaḥ paricaraṇīyāḥ Vte tvadīyāḥ Varcayaḥ raśmayaḥ Vśyenāso Vna aśvā dvava |
Vmārutaṃ Vśardhaḥ Vna marutsambandhī gaṇa dvava Vtuviṣvaṇasaḥ tuvisvanā adhikadhvanayo bhavanti ||
akāri brahma samidhāna tubhyaṃ śaṃsātyukthaṃ yajate vyū dhāḥ |
hotārmagniṃ manuṣo ni ṣedurnamasyanta uśijaḥ śaṃsamāyoḥ ||
akāri | brahma | sam'idhāna | tubhyam | śaṃsāti | uktham | yajate | vi | ū~ iti | dhāḥ | hotārm | agnim | manuṣaḥ | ni | seduḥ | namasyantaḥ | uśijaḥ | śaṃsam | āyoḥ || 11 ||
he Vsamidhāna samidhyamānāgne Vtubhyaṃ tvadarthaṃ Vbrahma stotram Vakāri asmābhiḥ kṛtam |
hotā Vukthaṃ śasrarūpaṃ stotraṃ Vśaṃsāti śaṃsati ||
ataḥ kāraṇāt asmabhyaṃ dhanaṃ Vvi Vdhāḥ vidhehi dadhāteśchandase luṅi ' bahulaṃ chandasi ' ityaḍabhāvaḥ ||
kiṃca Vāyoḥ manuṣyasya Vśaṃsa śaṃsanīyaṃ Vhotārṃ devānāmāhvātāram Vagniṃ Vtvāṃ Vnamasyantaḥ pūjayantaḥ Vuśijaḥ paścādilakṣaṇaṃ dhanaṃ kāmayamānāḥ Vmanuṣaḥ manuṣyā ṛtvijaḥ Vni Vṣeduḥ upāviśan |
tathā cānukrāntam— ' ayamihau jagatī pañcānuṣṭubhaḥ ' iti |
tathā ca sūtritam— ' ayamiha prathamo dhāyi dhātubhiriti tu rājanyavaiśyayorādhe ' ( āśva. śrau. 2. 17 ) iti ||
1. kha-ga-ca-ṇa-vardhitāraḥ | 2. la-sa-sādhanamuṣkāḥ | 3. ta-na-bha-sa-vyadhāḥ vidhehi | 4. kha- ga-ca-ṇa-na-bha-sa- ' dvitīyādyāḥ ' nāsti |
ayamiha prathamo dhāyi dhātṛbhirhotā yajiṣṭho adhvareṣvīḍyaḥ |
ayam | iha | prathamaḥ | dhāyi | dhātṛbhiḥ | hotā | yajiṣṭhaḥ | adhvareṣu | īḍyaḥ | yam | ardhavānaḥ | bhṛgavaḥ | virurucuḥ | citram | vimbam | viśeṣviśe || 1 ||

dhātubhiḥ yajñārthaṃ karma kurvadbhiradhvaryubhiḥ iha asmin yajñe hotā devānāmāhvātā yajiṣṭhaḥ atiśayena yaṣṭā adhvareṣu yāgeṣu īḍyaḥ ṛtvigbhiḥ stūyamānaḥ prathamaḥ sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ mukhyaḥ ayam āhavanīyādisthāneṣu pratyakṣopalabhyamāno'gniḥ dhāyi adhāyi nihitaḥ ||
sa cānye bhṛgavaḥ ca vaneṣu araṇyeṣu citraṃ dāvāgnirūpeṇa bahudhā darśanīyaṃ viśeṣviśe |
sarvasyā viśaḥ prajāyāḥ viśvaṃ vibhumīśvaraṃ yaṃ devānāṃ havirvāhakatvena prasiddhamagniṃ virurucuḥ dīsiyuktaṃ kurvanti sma |
prātaranuvākāśvinaśastrayorāmeye ṛtau ānuṣṭubhe chandasi 'agne kadā te' ityādyāḥ pañcarcaḥ |
sūtritaṃ ca - 'agne kadā te iti pañca' ( āśva. śrau. 4. 13 ) iti ||
adhā hi tvā jagṛbhre martāso viśvīḍyam ||
agne | kadā | te | ānuṣak | bhuvat | devasya | cetanam | adha | hi | tvā | jagṛbhre | martāsaḥ | viśvu | īḍyam || 2 ||
he agne adha ataḥ kāraṇāt devasya dyotamānasya te tava saṃbandhi cetanaṃ tejaḥ kadā ānuṣak anuṣaktaṃ bhuvat bhavet ||
hi yasmāt kāraṇāt martāsaḥ manuṣyāḥ viśvu viḍbhiḥ prajābhiḥ īḍyaṃ stutyaṃ tvā tvāṃ jagṛbhre jagṛhire gṛhṇanti ||
ṛta'vānam | vicetasam | paryantaḥ | dhāma'iva | stubhiḥ | viśveṣām | adhvarāṇām | haskartāram | dame'dame || 3 ||

^ṛtāvānam amāyinaṃ ^vicetasaṃ viśiṣṭajñānaṃ ^stubhiḥ nakṣatraiḥ paridhṛtaṃ ^dhāmiva visphuliṅgaiḥ sametaṃ ^viśveṣāṃ sarveṣām ^adhvarāṇāṃ yajñānāṃ ^haskatīraṃ prabhāsakaṃ ^vṛddheḥ2 kartāraṃ vā2 agniṃ ^paśyantaḥ ṛtvigādayaḥ ^damedame sarvasmin yajñagṛhe|

āśuṃ dūtaṃ vivasvataḥ viśvā yarṣaṇīrabhi | ā jabhruḥ ketumayavo bhṛgavāṇaṃ viśorviśe || 4 || āśum | dūtam | vivasvataḥ | viśvāḥ | yaḥ | carṣaṇīḥ | abhi | ā | jabhruḥ | ketum | āyavaḥ | bhṛgavāṇam | viśo'viśe || 4 ||

'sedu sa evāgniḥ ' 'dūtyaṃ devānāṃ dūtakarma vcikitvān jānan vdivaḥ svargasya vārodhanam ārohanam ārohaṇārhaṃ devānāṃ sthānaṃ ca vvidvān jānan vantaḥ dyāvāpṛthivyormadhye vīyate gacchati ||

' agne tamadya ' ityetad daśamaṃ sūktaṃ vāmadevasyārṣam āgneyam |

tathā cānukramaṇikā— ' agne tamadya padapāṅkaṃ ' pañcamī mahāpadapaṅktiranyoṣṇi k caturthī ṣaṭpanthānyā vā saptamyāḥ pañcakau mukhyau tṛtīyaḥ saptako navakaścāṣṭamyāḥ pañcakaḥ pādaścatuṣkaḥ saptakaścaiṣambhraśca ' iti |
idaṃ kṛtsnamapi sūktaṃ padapaṅkticchandaskaṃ ' pañcakāścatvāraḥ ṣaṭkaścaikāścaturthaścatuṣko vā padapaṅktiḥ ' ityukta- lakṣaṇopetatvāt |
caturthīṣaṣṭhīsaptamyaḥ ' ābhīṣṭe aya ', ' ghṛtaṃ na pūtaṃ ', ' kṛtaṃ ciddhi pmā ' ityetāstisra uṣṇikaḥ padapaṅktayo vā |
atra saptamyaṣṭamyoḥ padapaṅktyuṣṇihoḥ paribhāṣāktapādavicchedapāvādāya prakārāntareṇa vicchedaḥ kṛtaḥ |
sūtritaṃ ca— ' agne tamadyāśvaṃ na stomairityājyam ' ( āśva. śrau. 8. 12 ) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca— ' agniṃ pratyeyādagne tamadyāśvaṃ na stomaiḥ ' ( āśva. śrau. 2. 7 ) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca— ' agne tamadyāśvaṃ na stomairiti saṃyājye ' ( āśva. śrau. 2. 8 ) iti ||

1. kha-ga-gha-ca-ṇa-pa-la-sa-yajamānasādhanam | 2. ta-la-hirādeśaḥ | 3. va-prakṛteḥ śrubhāvaśca | 4. na-la-sa-' te ' nāsti | 5. kha-ga-ca-ṇa-ta-na-bha-duhisaḥ | 6. kha-ga-gha-ca-ṇa-na-bha-la-sa-' āgneyaṃ ' nāsti | 7. ta-padapaṃkti | 8. kha-ga-ca-ṇa-na-bha-sa-ityuktalakṣaṇatvāt |

agnḙ ta॒madyā̭śvaṃ na stomai̭: kratuṃ na bha॒draṃ hṛ̭di॒spṛśa̭m | ṛ॒dhyāmā̭ ta॒ ohai̭: ||1|| agnḙ | ta॒m | adya̭ | a॒śvam | na | stomai̭: | kratṷm | na | bha॒dram | hṛ̭di॒spṛśa̭m | ṛ॒dhyāma̭ | te | ohai̭: || 1 ||
ha vagne vadya asminnahani vayamṛtvigādayaḥ vohaiḥ indrādiprāpakaiḥ vstomaiḥ stotrasamūhaiḥ vtaṃ vprasiddhaṃ vte vtvām vṛdhyāma samarthayāmaḥ |
vaśvaṃ vna voḍhāramaśvamiva tathā haviṣo vāhakaṃ vkratuṃ vna kartāramiva |
sūtritaṃ ca - 'adhā hyagne ṛtorbhadrasyā- miṣṭe adya gīrbhirgṛṇanta ebhinoṃ arkaiḥ' ( āśva. śrau. 2. 8 ) iti ||

adhā̭ hya॒gne kra॒torbha॒drasya॒ dakṣa̭sya sādho̭: | ra॒thīṛ॒tasya̭ bṛ॒hato̭ ba॒bhūtha̭ || 2 || adha | hi | agnḙ | kra॒toḥ | bha॒drasya̭ | dakṣa̭sya | sādho̭: | ra॒thīḥ | ṛ॒tasya̭ | bṛ॒hata̭ḥ | ba॒bhūtha̭ ||2||
vadhā vhi idānīmeva he vagne vtvaṃ vkratoḥ asmadīyasya yāgasya vrathīḥ netā vbabhūtha bhavasi ||
'bhadrasya' bhajanī- yasya 'dakṣasya' pravṛddhasya 'sādhoḥ' abhīṣṭaphalānāṃ sādhakasya 'ṛtasya' satyabhūtasya 'bṛhataḥ' mahataḥ ||

e॒bhino̭ṃ a॒rkairbhā॒ no a॒rvāṅ sva॒rṇa jyoti̭: | agnḙ vi॒śvebhi̭: su॒manā̭ a॒rnīkai̭: || 3 || e॒bhiḥ | naḥ | a॒rkaiḥ | bhava̭ | naḥ | a॒rvāṅ | sva̭ḥ | na | jyoti̭: | agnḙ | vi॒śvebhi̭: | su॒manā̭: | a॒rnīkai̭: || 3 ||

he vagne vjyotiḥ jyotiṣmān vsvarṇa sūrya iva tathā vviśvebhiḥ viśvaiḥ samastaiḥ vanīkaiḥ tejobhiḥ vsumanāḥ śobhanamanaskastvaṃ vnaḥ asmadīyaiḥ vebhiḥ etaiḥ varkaiḥ arcanīyaiḥ stotraiḥ vnaḥ asmākam varvāṅ abhimukhaḥ vbhava ||

āmi̭ṣṭe a॒dya gī॒rbhirgṛ̭ṇa॒nto'gnḙ dā॒śema̭ | pra tai di॒vo na sta॒naya̭nti śu॒ṣmāḥ ||4|| āmi̭ṣṭe | a॒dya | gī॒rbhiḥ | gṛ̭ṇa॒ntaḥ | agnḙ | dā॒śema̭ | pra | te | di॒vaḥ | na | sta॒naya̭nti | śu॒ṣmāḥ || 4 ||
vatha asmin divase ha vame vābhiḥ vgīrbhiḥ stutirūpābhirvāgbhiḥ vgṛṇantaḥ tvāṃ stuvanto vayamṛtvigādayaḥ vte tubhyaṃ vdāśema havīṃṣi dadyāma |
vdivo vna sūryasya raśmaya iva vte tvadīyāḥ vśuṣmāḥ śodhakā jvālāḥ vpra vsnayanti prakarṣeṇa śabdayante |
divo na meghā iva tvadīyā jvālāḥ śabdayante |
tav svādiṣṭhāya saṃdaśirā cidaha idā cidaktoḥ | śriye rukmo na rocata upāke || 5 ||
tav | svādiṣṭhā | agne | sama'dṛṣṭiḥ | idā | cit | ahaḥ | idā | cit | aktoḥ | śriye | rukmaḥ | na | rocate | upāke || 5 ||
he vagne vsvādiṣṭhā svādutamā priyatamā vtava tvadīyā vsaṃdaṣṭiḥ dīptiḥ vahaḥ vidā vcit divasasyedānīṃ ca vaktoḥ vidā vcit |
akkuriti rātrināma ‘śarvarī aktuḥ ūrmyā’ ( ni. 1. 7. 4 ) iti rātrināmasu pāṭhāt |
vrukmo vna alaṃkāra iva vśriye padārthamāśritum vupāke antike |
upāka ityantikanāma ‘āke upāke’ ( ni. 2. 16. 7 ) iti tannāmasu pāṭhāt |
ghṛtaṃ na pūtaṃ tanūrapāḥ śuci hiraṇyam | tattai rukmo na rocata svadhāvaḥ || 6 ||
ghṛtam | na | pūtam | tanūḥ | arepāḥ | śuci | hiraṇyam | tav | te | rukmaḥ | na | rocata | svadhāvaḥ || 6 ||
annavannagne vpūtaṃ śodhitaṃ vghṛtaṃ vna ājyamiva vtanūḥ tvadīyā mūrtiḥ varepāḥ pāparahitā bhavati |
vśuci śuddhaṃ vhiraṇyaṃ hitaramaṇīyaṃ vte tvadīyaṃ vtava prasiddhaṃ tejaḥ vrukmo vna bhūṣaṇamiva vrocata rocate bhāsate |
kṛtaṃ ciddhi ṣmā sanemi dveṣo'gne inoṣi martāt | itthā yajamānādatāvaḥ ||7||
kṛtam | cit | hi | sma | sanemi | dveṣaḥ | agne | inoṣi | martāt | itthā | yajamānāt | ṛta'vaḥ || 7 ||
he vṛtāvaḥ3 satyavan vagne vkṛtaṃ vcit yajamānena kṛtamapi vsanemi ciraṃtanam |
sanemīti purāṇanāma ‘sanemi’ pūrvyam’ ( ni. 3. 27. 4 ) iti purāṇanāmasu pāṭhāt |
1. gha-ca-pa-bha-la-dag | 2. la-arvāke antike | 3. kha-ga-ca-na-sa-ṛtavaḥ | 4. gha-ṇa-ta- pa-bha-pāpaṃ kṛtamapi | 5. ta-pravayāḥ sanemi | 6. kha-ga-gha-ca-ṇa-na-bha-sa-pāpāta |
ittheti sāyaṇāmaitat ‘addhā itthā’ (ni. 3. 10. 5) iti tannāmasu pāṭhāt |
śivā naḥ sakhyā santu ātrāgre deveṣu yuṣme |
śivā | naḥ | sakhyā | santu | ātrā | agne | deveṣu | yuṣme iti |
sā | naḥ | nābhiḥ | sadane | sasmin | ūdhan || 8 ||
he agne naḥ asmadīyāni sakhyā sakhyāni sakhitvāni ātrā ātrāṇi ātrasambandheni karmāṇi deveṣu dyotamāneṣu yuṣme yuṣmāsu ||

vi pāhyagre gṛṇate manīṣāṃ khaṃ verpasā tuvijāt starvā naḥ | viśvairbhirdvāvanaḥ śukra daivaistanno rāsva sumaha bhūrī manma || 2 || vi | sāhi | agre | gṛṇate | manīṣām | kham | verpasā | tuvi'jāta | starvā naḥ | viśvaibhiḥ | yat | vvanaḥ | śukra | daivaiḥ | tat | naḥ | rāsva | su'mahaḥ | bhūri | manma ||2||
he tuvijāta mathanena araṇidvārā yajñādikarmasu bahujanmana agne stavānaḥ ṛtvigādibhiḥ stūyamānastvaṃ vepasā yajñādikarmaṇā |
vepa iti karmanāma ‘vepaḥ vepaḥ viṣṭī’ (ni. 2. 1. 5) iti karmanāmasu pāṭhāt |
manīṣāṃ stutiṃ gṛṇate kurvate yajamānāya khaṃ yajamānaprāpyasya puṇya- lokasya dvāraṃ vi pāhi vivya |
he śukra dīpyamānāgne tvaṃ viśvaibhiḥ viśvaiḥ sarvaiḥ ||
daivaiḥ indrādibhiḥ saha yat paścādidhanaṃ vvanaḥ yajamānebhyaḥ prayaccheḥ ||
he sumahaḥ śobhanatejaskāgne bhūri prabhūtaṃ manma mananīyaṃ tat dhanaṃ naḥ asmabhyaṃ rāsva dehi ||
tathā ca sūtritaṃ- ‘tvadagne kādhyā tvanmanīṣāḥ sa ptanathā sahasā jāyamānaḥ’ (āśva. śrau. 2. 19) iti ||

tvadagne kāvyā tvanmanīṣāstvadukthā jāyante rādhyāni | tvadaiti draviṇaṃ vīrapeśā itthādhiye dāśuṣe martyāya || 3 || tvat | agre | kāvyā | tvat | manīṣāḥ | tvat | ukthā | jāyante | rādhyāni | tvat | eti | draviṇam | vīra'peśāḥ | itthā'dhiye | dāśuṣe | martyāya || 3 ||
he agre kāvyā kāvyāni havirvahanadevatāyanadīnāgni saṃbandhīni karmāṇi ādhvaryavāṇi karmāṇi vā tvat tvattaḥ jāyante utpadyante |
manīṣāḥ stutirūpā vācaḥ tvat eva jāyante |
rādhyāni rātuṃ yogyāni ukthā ukthāni śastrāṇi tvan tvatto jāyante |
ittheti satyanāmasu pāṭhāt satyakarmaṇe dāśuṣe havīṃṣi dattavate martyāya manuṣyāya yajamānāya vīrapeśāḥ |
draviṇaṃ paśvādidhanaṃ tvan tvattaḥ eti nirgacchati |

1. ta-mathanīya | 2. ta-yajamānena prāpyasya; na-yajamānena prārthyasya | 3. kha-ga-ca-ṇa-na-pha- bha-sa- ‘divādibhyaḥ... hirādeśaḥ’ nāsti | 4. ca-ṇa-na-vāvanaḥ | 5. kha-ga-ca-bha-na-la-sa- ‘manma’ nāsti | 6. na-la-sa-bhavataḥ | 7. ca-pha-tvadu tvattaḥ |

tvadvājī vājaṃbharo vihāyā abhiṣṭikṛjjāyate satyaśuṣmaḥ | tvadyirdevajūto mayobhustvadāśurjuvā agne arvā || 4 || tvat | vājī | vājam'bharaḥ | vi'hāyāḥ | abhiṣṭi'kṛt | jāyate | satya'śuṣmaḥ | tvat | rayiḥ | deva'jūtaḥ | mayaḥ'bhuḥ | tvat | āśuḥ | juju'vān | agne | arvā || 5 ||
' saṃjñāyāṃ bhṛttruji ' iti vājaśabde karmaṇyupapade khacpratyayaḥ |

āre asmadarmatisāre ahaṃ āre viśvāṃ durmatiṃ yannipāsīṃ | doṣā śiva: sahasa: sūno agne yaṃ deva ā citsarvase svasti || 6 || āre | asmat | amatim | āre | ahaṃ: | āre | viśvām | du:matim | yat | nipāsīṃ | doṣā | śiva: | sahasa: | sūno iti | agne | yam | deva: | ā | cit | sarvase | svasti ||6||
he agne doṣā rātrau śiva: śivakara: deva: dyotamānastvaṃ yaṃ yānasmān svasti avināśāya ā sacase parita: sevase |
yat yasmān kāraṇāt nipāsi yajamānān nitarāṃ pālayasi |
tebhya: asmat asmat: amarti pāparūpāmajñānecchām āre dūre kuru |
he ˇagne ˇyaḥ yajamānaḥ ˇte tubhyam ˇidhmaṃ homasādhanaṃ samijñātaṃ ˇjabharat āharat ||
ˇśaśramāṇaḥ ˇidhmamāharaṇe ˇābhyan ˇmahaḥ mahataḥ ˇtava ˇā ˇanīkam |
tejaśca ˇsaparyan paricaran yo yajamānaḥ ˇdoṣaાં ˇprati rātriṃ lakṣīkṛtya ˇupasaṃ prati upaḥkālaṃ ca lakṣīkṛtya |
ˇidhānaḥ ˇindhānastvāṃ dīptiyuktaṃ karoti ˇpuṣyan prajābhiḥ paśubhiśca puṣṭaḥ san ˇsaḥ yajamānaḥ ˇamitrān śatrūn ˇghnan hiṃsan ˇrayiṃ dhanaṃ ˇsacate sevate |

mahaścidagna enaso abhīka ūrdhvāddevānāmuta martyānām | mā te sakhāyaḥ sadamidriṣāma yacchā tokāya tanayāya śaṃ yoḥ || 5 || mahaḥ | cit | agne | enasaḥ | abhīke | ūrdhvāt | devānām | uta | martyānām | mā | te | sakhāyaḥ | sadam | it | riṣāma | yaccha | tokāya | tanayāya | śam | yoḥ ||5||
he agne devānām indrādīnām uta api ca martyānām manuṣyāṇām abhīke antike |
asmābhiryatpāpaṃ kṛtaṃ mahaścit mahato'pi ūrdhvāt vistṛtādasmāt enasaḥ pāpāt te tvadīyāḥ sakhāyaḥ mitrabhūtāḥ stotāro vayaṃ sadamit sarvadaiva mā riṣāma mā hiṃsitā bhūma |
he agne tvaṃ tokāya putrāya tanayāya pautrāya śaṃ pāparūpopadravāṇāṃ śāntiṃ yoḥ sukṛtotpāditaṃ sukhaṃ ca yaccha dehi ||

yathā ha tyadvasavo gauryaṃ citpadi sitāmamuñcatā yajatrāḥ | evo ṣvasmanmuñcatā vyaṃhaḥ pra tāriṇe prataraṃ na āyuḥ || 6 || yathā | ha | tyat | vasavaḥ | gauryam | cit | padi | sitām | amuñcata | yajatrāḥ | eva | iti | su | asmat | muñcata | vi | aṃhaḥ | pra | tāri | agne | pra'taram | naḥ | āyuḥ ||6||
yajatrāḥ yajanīyāḥ pūjārhā he vasavaḥ nivāsayitāraḥ 1 agnayaḥ yūyaṃ yathā ha yathaiva tyat tvāṃ tāṃ padi pāde sitāṃ baddhāṃ gauryaṃ cit gaurīṃ gāmapi amuñcata tyaktavanto bhūyāsta |
evo evameva asmat asmattaḥ aṃhaḥ pāpaṃ su atyantaṃ vi muñcata vimuktaṃ kuruta |
he agne tvayā prataraṃ pravṛddhaṃ naḥ asmadīyam āyuḥ pra tāri pravṛddhaṃ kriyatām ||
‘ pratyamiḥ ’ iti pañcakaṃ tṛtīyaṃ sūktaṃ vāmadevasyārṣaṃ traiṣṭubhamāgneyaṃ tattanmantravarṇābhidheyāpaḥprabhṛti- daivataṃ vā |
tathā cānukrāntaṃ—‘ pratyamiḥ pañca liṅgoktadaivataṃ tveke ’ iti |

pratyabhiruṣasāmagramasyadvibhātīnāṃ sumanā ratnadheyam | yātaminā sukṛtau duroṇamutsūryo jyotiṣā deva eti || 1 || prati | agniḥ | uṣasām | agram | adyat | vi'bhātīnām | su'manāḥ | ratna'dheyam | yātam | aśvinā | su'kṛtau | duroṇam | ut | sūryaḥ | jyotiṣā | devaḥ | eti || 1 ||
sumanaḥ śobhanamanaskaḥ agniḥ vibhātīnāṃ vyucchantīnām uṣasām upadevatānāṃ ratnadheyaṃ ratnadhānam |
agraṃ prati pūrvakālaṃ 2 lakṣīkṛtya adyat pravṛddho bhavati |
he ᵛaśvinā aśvinau yuvāṃ ᵛsukṛtaḥ yajamānasya ᵛduroṇaṃ gṛham |
duroṇe' iti gṛhanāma ‘duroṇe duryāḥ ’ ( ni. 3. 4. 7 ) iti gṛhanāmasu pāṭhāt |
ᵛsūryaḥ ṛtvigādīnāṃ prerakaḥ ᵛdevaḥ ᵛdyotayan svena tejasā ᵛut ᵛeti upaḥkāle prādurbhavatītyarthaḥ ||

ūrdhvaṃ bhānuṃ savitā devo aśreddrapsaṃ darvivaddhraviṣo na satvā | anu vrataṃ varuṇo yanti mitro yatsūryaṃ divi ārohayanti || 2 || ūrdhvam | bhānum | savitā | devaḥ | aśret | drapsam | darvivat | go'iṣaḥ | na | satvā | anu | vratam | varuṇaḥ | yanti | mitraḥ | yat | sūryam | divi | ā'rohayanti || 2 ||
ᵛsavitā prerakaḥ ᵛdevaḥ ᵛūrdhvam unmukhaṃ ᵛbhānum ᵛaśret āśrayati |
ᵛyat yadā raśmayaḥ ᵛsūrya ᵛdivi dyuloke ᵛārohayanti ārohaṇaṃ

he ᵥdeva dyotamāna sūrya tvaṃ jagajjihvātmakasya rasasyādānārthaṃ ᵥtantuṃ ᵥraśmasamūhaṃ ᵥviharan vistārāyan ᵥasitaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ ᵥvasma naktaṃcarāṇāṃ nivāsabhūtāṃ rātrim ᵥavacchayan avācīnaṃ² yathā bhavati tathā saṃvṛṇvan³ |
ᵥvahiṣṭhebhiḥ voḍhumatyantaṃ śaktaiḥ aśvaiḥ ᵥyāsi gamanamārgaṃ gacchasi |
asyāmṛci pūrvārdhe sūryasya pratyakṣamataṃ pratipādyottarārdhe parokṣamarthaṃ pratipādayitumāha |
ᵥdividhataḥ dhunvānāḥ ᵥsūryasya saṃbandhinḥ ᵥraśmayaḥ kiraṇāḥ ᵥapsu antarikṣe |
āpa ityantarikṣanāma ‘ākāśam āpaḥ pṛthivī’ (ni. 1. 3. 8) iti tannāmasu pāṭhāt |
ᵥantaḥ madhye ᵥcamevaṃ carmavat sthitaṃ ᵥtamaḥ andhakāram ᵥavādhuḥ avācīnamadadhuḥ |
anāyato anibaddhaḥ kuthāyaṃ nyuḍuttāno'va padyate na |
karyā yāti svadhayā ko dadarśa divaḥ skambhaḥ samṛtaḥ pāti nākam ||
anāyataḥ | ani'baddhaḥ | kuthā | ayam | nyaṅ | uttānaḥ | ava | padyate | na | karyā | yāti | svadhayā | kaḥ | dadarśa | divaḥ | skambhaḥ | sama'sṛtaḥ | pāti | nākam || 5 ||
tadviparīta: ᵥanāyataḥ āsīnaḥ san ᵥayaṃ pratyakṣopalabhyamāno maṇḍalābhimānī sūryaḥ ᵥanibaddhaḥ kenāpi baddho na kriyate |
api cāyaṃ sūryaḥ ᵥnyaṅ avāṅmukhaḥ san kenacit ᵥkathā kathaṃ ᵥna ᵥava ᵥpadyate na hiṃsyate |
kiṃcāyam ᵥuttānaḥ ūrdhvamukhatvena tiṣṭhan ᵥkathā ᵥsvadhayā kena balena ᵥyāti gacchati |
api ca ᵥdivaḥ dyulokasya ᵥskambhaḥ stambhaḥ ᵥsamṛtaḥ nākena⁶ samavetaḥ sūryaḥ ᵥnākaṃ svargaṃ ᵥpāti pālayati |
‘pratyamṛṣasaḥ’ iti pañca ca caturthaṃ sūktaṃ vāmadevayārṣaṃ traiṣṭubhamāgneyaṃ māntravarṇikadaivataṃ vā |
ā nāsatyorugāyā rathenemaṃ yajñamupa no yātamuccha ||
prati | agniḥ | uṣasaḥ | jātavedāḥ | aruvyat | devaḥ | rocamānāḥ | mahaḥ'bhiḥ | ā | nāsatyā | uru'gāyā | rathena | imam | yajñam | upa | naḥ | yātam | accha || 1 ||
ᵥdevaḥ dyotamānaḥ ᵥjātavedāḥ jātadhanaḥ ᵥagniḥ ᵥmahobhiḥ tejobhiḥ ᵥrocamānāḥ dīpyamānāḥ ᵥuṣasaḥ ᵥprati upaso lakṣīkṛtya ᵥasyat prabuddho bhavati |
ᵥurugāyā prabhūtagamanau he ᵥnāsatyā aśvinau ᵥrathena ᵥnaḥ asmadīyam ᵥimaṃ ᵥyajñam ᵥaccha abhimukham ᵥupa ᵥyātam upagacchatam ||
1. ṇa-tantuṃ rajjum | 2. gha-ca-la-arvācīnam | 3. kha-ga-gha-ta-pa-bha-la-sa-atruvan; ca- ṇa-ja-pha-akṛṇvan | 4. ba-pha-ūrdhvamukhaḥ | 5. ca-pha-skandhaḥ | 6. kha-ga-ca-ṇa-pha-ṛtena |
ūrdhvaṃ ketuṃ savitā devo aśrejjyotirviśvasmai bhuvanāya kṛṇvan |
ā prā dyāvāpṛthivī antarikṣaṃ vi sūryo raśmibhirjekitānaḥ ||
ūrdhvam | ketum | savitā | devaḥ | aśret | jyotiḥ | viśvasmai | bhuvanāya | kṛṇvan | ā | prāḥ | dyāvāpṛthivī iti | antarikṣam | vi | sūryaḥ | raśmibhiḥ | jekitānaḥ || 2 ||
viśvasmai sarvasmai bhuvanāya lokāya jyotiḥ tejaḥ kṛṇvan kurvan savitā prerakaḥ devaḥ ūrdhvam unmukhaṃ ketuṃ prakāśakaṃ bhānum aśret āśrayati |
vi cekitānaḥ sarvaṃ viśeṣeṇa paśyan sūryaḥ raśmibhiḥ svakīyaiḥ kiraṇaiḥ dyāvāpṛthivī dyulokabhūlokau antarikṣaṃ ca ā prāḥ samantādapūrayat ||
prabodhayantī suvitārya devyuṣā īyate suyujā rathena ||
āvahantī | aruṇī | jyotiṣā | ā | agāt | mahī | citrā | raśmibhiḥ | jekitānā | prabodhayantī | suvitārya | devī | uṣāḥ | īyate | suyujā | rathena || 3 ||
jyotiṣā tejasā yuktā mahī mahatī raśmibhiḥ kiraṇaiḥ citrā darśanīyā jekitānā jānatī uṣāḥ āgāt āgacchat |
kiṃca prabodhayantī susān prabuddhān kurvatī devī dyotamānā uṣāḥ suyujā śobhanayukena rathena suvitāya sukhaprāptaye īyate gacchati ||
ā vāṃ vahiṣṭhā iha te vahantu rathā aśvāsa upaso vyuṣṭau |
ime hi vāṃ madhupeyāya somā asmin‌yajñe vṛṣaṇā mādayethām ||
ā | vām | vahiṣṭhāḥ | iha | te | vahantu | rathāḥ | aśvāsaḥ | upasaḥ | vyuṣṭau | ime | hi | vām | madhupeyāya | somāḥ | asmin | yajñe | vṛṣaṇā | mādayethām || 4 ||
he aśvinau iha yajñe vahiṣṭhāḥ voḍhatamāḥ te prasiddhāḥ rathāḥ raṃhaṇā gantāraḥ aśvāsaḥ aśvāḥ vāṃ yuvām upasaḥ upodevatāyāḥ vyuṣṭau vyuṣṭanakāle vā vahantu samantāt nayantu |
hi yasmāt kāraṇāt he vṛṣaṇā vṛṣaṇau kāmāનાં vardhitārau he aśvinau ime somāḥ vāṃ yuvāṃ madhupeyāya madhoḥ somasya pānāya asmin‌yajñe mādayethāṃ harṣayethām ||
anāyato anibaddhaḥ kuthāyaṃ nyaṅ‌uttāno'va padyate na |
kayā yāti svadhayā ko dadarśa divaḥ skambhaḥ samrtaḥ pāti nārkam ||
anāyataḥ | ani'baddhaḥ | kuthā | ayam | nyaṅ | uttānaḥ | ava | padyate | na |

tena vdasyūna śatrūna vpra vmṛṇa jahi ||

1. ta-dhanasya īkṣe | 2. kha-pa-pha-bha-' ca ' nāsti | 3. kha-pa-pha-bha-' kayā ' nāsti | 4. kha-ga-ca-ṇa-pa-pha-bha-yaḥ ṛṣvaḥ | 5. ta-na-la-sa-' mahānindraḥ ' nāsti | 6. kha-ga-ca-ṇa-pa-pha-bha-yad bhūri bahupi dhanam |

na॒ ṣṭuta॒ indra̭ nū gṝ॒ṇāna॒ iṣa̭ṃ ja॒ri॒tre॒ na॒dyo॒ na pī̭peḥ | a॒kāri̭ te॒ hari̭vo॒ brahma̭ na॒vya॒ṃ dhiyā॒ syāma̭ ra॒thya̭ḥ sa॒dāsā̭ḥ || 11 || nu | stutaḥ | indra | nu | gṝṇānaḥ | iṣam | jaritre | naryaḥ | na | pīperiti pīpeḥ | akāri | te | harivaḥ | brahma | navyam | dhiyā | syāma | rathyaḥ | sadāsāḥ || 11 || pūrvaṃ vyākhyātā || || 4 ||
‘ ā yā॒tvindraḥ ’ ityekādaśarcamekādaśaṃ sūktaṃ vāmadevasyārṣaṃ traiṣṭubhamaindram |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘ ā yātvindro'vasa iti marutvatīyam ’ ( ādha. śrau. 7. 5 ) iti ||
ā yā॒tvindro'va̭su॒ upa̭ na॒ iha̭ stu॒taḥ sa॒dha

ā yātvindro diva ā pṛthivyā makṣu samudrāduta vā purīṣāt | svarṇarādavase no marutvānparāvatau vā sadanādṛtasya || 3 || ā | yātu | indraḥ | divaḥ | ā | pṛthivyāḥ | makṣu | samudrāt | uta | vā | purīṣāt | svaḥ'narāt | avase | naḥ | marutvān | parāvataḥ | vā | sadanāt | ṛtasya || 3 ||
^marutvān marudbhiḥ sahitaḥ ^indraḥ ^naḥ asmākam ^avase rakṣaṇāya ^divaḥ svargalokāt ^ā ^yātu āgacchatu |
samudra dṛśyantarikṣanāma 'sagaraḥ samudraḥ adhvaram' (ni. 1. 3. 15) iti tannāmasu pāṭhāt |
purīṣamityudakanāma 'madhu purīṣaṃ pippalam' (ni. 1. 12. 12) iti tannāmasu pāṭhāt |
^svarṇarāt svarādityayo naro netā yasya tasmāllokādvā āyātu |

sthūrasya rāyo bṛhato ya īśe tamu stvāma vidatheṣbindram | yo vāyunā jayati gormatīṣu pra dhṛṣṇuyā nayati vasyo accha || 4 || sthūrasya | rāyaḥ | bṛhataḥ | yaḥ | īśe | tam | ū~ iti | stvām | vidatheṣu | indram | yaḥ | vāyunā | jayati | go'matīṣu | pra | dhṛṣṇuyā | nayati | vasyaḥ | accha || 4 ||
^yaḥ indraḥ ^sthūrasya sthūlasya ^bṛhataḥ mahataḥ ^rāyaḥ dhanasya ^īśe īṣṭe ^vidatheṣu yajñeṣu |
^yaḥ indraḥ ^vāyunā prāṇarūpeṇa balena ^gormatīṣu senāsu ^jayati śatrūn vijayate |
^dhṛṣṇuyā dhṛṣṇuḥ pragalbho ya indraḥ stotṛn ^vasyaḥ vasīyaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ paścādidhanam ^accha abhi ^pra ^nayati prāpayati |

upa yo namo narmasi stabhāyanniryati vāceṃ janayantyajñai | ṛñjānaḥ puruvāraṃ ukthairendraṃ kṛṇvīta sadaneṣu hotā || 5 || upa | yaḥ | namaḥ | narmasi | stabhāyan | iryati | vācam | janayan | yajñai | ṛñjānaḥ | puru'vāraḥ | ukthaiḥ | ā | indram | kṛṇvīta | sadaneṣu | hotā || 5 ||
^upa ^stabhāyan lokānupastambhayan ^yajadhyai yadhuṃ ^vācaṃ garjitalakṣaṇāṃ vācaṃ ^janayan prajanayan ^ṛasānaḥ prasādhyamānaḥ |
indro haviṣā tṛptaḥ san vṛṣṭidvārā annaṃ prayacchati tena cānnena punaryajñaḥ prajāyata ityarthaḥ |
dhiṣā yadi dhiṣaṇyantaḥ saraṇyāntasadanto adrimauśijasya gohe |
ā duroṣāḥ pāstyasya hotā yo nau mahāntaṃsaṃvaraṇeṣu vahniḥ ||
dhiṣā | yadi | dhiṣaṇyantaḥ | saraṇyān | sadantaḥ | adrim | auśijasya | gohe | ā | duroṣāḥ | pāstyasya | hotā | yaḥ | naḥ | mahān | savaraṇeṣu | vahniḥ || 6 ||
tamindraṃ ^dhiṣā stutyā ^yadi yadā ^saraṇyān upāgaccheyuḥ tadā sa indraḥ ^ā yātu |
^naḥ asmākaṃ ^savaraṇeṣu śatrusaṃbandhiṣu nirodheṣu ^vahniḥ voḍhā ^pāstyasya pasye gṛhe vasatā yajamānena ^hotā āhvatā ^duroṣāḥ dustarakrodhaḥ ^yaḥ indraḥ ^mahān prabhṛto bhavati |
satrā yardī bhāvrasya vṛṣṇaḥ siṣakti śuṣmaḥ stuvate bharāya |
guhā yadīmauśijasya gohe pra yādviye prāyase madāya ||
satrā | yat | īm | bhāvrasya | vṛṣṇaḥ | siṣakti | śuṣmaḥ | stuvate | bharāya | guhā | yat | īm | auśijasya | gohe | pra | yat | dhriye | pra | ayase | madāya || 7 ||
tasya ^vṛṣṇaḥ kāmānāṃ varṣiturindrasya saṃbandhī ^īm eṣaḥ ^śuṣmaḥ balaṃ ^stuvate stotraṃ kurvantaṃ yajamānaṃ ^siṣakti sevate iti ^yat tat ^satrā satyameva |
^īm etadannam ^auśijasya yajamānasya ^bharāya bhartuṃ ^guhā guhāyāṃ guhārupe hṛdaye ^pra bhavatīti ^yat tatsatyam |
^ayase gamanāya kāmānāṃ prāptaye ^madāya harṣāya tatra yadyalaṃ prabhavati tatsatyam |

vi yadvarāṃsi parvatasya vṛṇve paryobhirjinve apāṃ javā~si | vidadvaurasya gavayasya gohe yadī vājāya sudhyo vahanti || 8 || vi | yat | varāṃsi | parvatasya | vṛṇve | paryaḥ | bhiḥ | jinve | apām | javā~si | vidat | gaurasya | gavayasya | gohe | yadi | vājāya | su'dhyaḥ | vahanti || 8 ||
indraḥ ᵥparvatasya meghasya ᵥvarāṃsi dvārāṇi ᵥvi ᵥvṛṇve vivṛtāni kṛtavāniti ᵥyat |
ᵥapāṃ udakānāṃ ᵥjavā~si vegān ᵥpayobhiḥ jalaiḥ ᵥjinve pyāyayatīti yat |
ᵥyadi yadā ᵥsudhyaḥ śobhana- karmāṇī yajamānāḥ ᵥvājāya annāya ᵥvahanti indraṃ prāpnuvanti tadā ᵥgohe gṛhe ᵥgaurasya gauramṛgasya ᵥgavayasya gavayamṛgasya ca ᵥvidat tau dvau paśū labhate iti yat |
abhyudayeṣṭau indrasya pradātuḥ ‘ bhadrā te hastā ’ iti yājyā |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘ dīrghaste asvadakuśo bhadrā te hastā sukṛtota pāṇī ’ (āśva. śrau. 3.13 ) iti ||

bhadrā te hastā sukṛtota pāṇī prayantārā stuvate rādhe indra | kā te nirṣattiḥ kimu no mamatisa kiṃ nordahu harṣe dātvā u~ || 9 || bhadrā | te | hastā | su'kṛtota | pāṇī | iti | pra'yantārā | stuvate | rādhaḥ | indra | kā | te | ni'rpattiḥ | kim | ū~ iti | no | iti | mamatisa | kim | na | uta'uta | ū~ iti | harṣe | dātavai | ū~ iti || 9 ||
he ᵥindra ᵥte tvadīyo ᵥbhadrā bhadrau kalyāṇau ᵥhastā hastau ᵥsukṛtā sukṛtau śobhanakarmāṇau bhavataḥ |
ᵥuta api ca ᵥpāṇī tvadīyo hastau ᵥstuvate stotre yajamānāya ᵥrādhaḥ dhanaṃ ᵥprayantārā prayantārau pradātārau bhavataḥ |
he indra ᵥte tvadīyā ᵥnirpattiḥ niṣadanaṃ sthitiḥ ᵥkā |
svasmān ᵥkimu kimarthaṃ ᵥno ᵥmamatisa na mādayasi |
ᵥkim ᵥududu kimarthameva ᵥdātavai asmākaṃ dhanaṃ dātuṃ ᵥna ᵥharṣe hṛṣṭo na bhavasi ’ ||
aindrasya vātraghnasya paśoḥ ‘ evā vasvaḥ ’ iti haviṣo yājyā |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘ evā vasva indraḥ samrāḍyadvāgavadatyavicetanāni ’ (āśva. śrau. 3. 8 ) iti ||

evā vasva indraḥ satyaḥ samrāḍḍhantāṃ vṛtraṃ varivaḥ pūrvai kaḥ | puruṣṭut kratvā naḥ śagdhi rāyo bhakṣīya te'vaso daivyasya || 10 || eva | vasvaḥ | indraḥ | satyaḥ | sam'rāṭ | hantāṃ | vṛtram | varivaḥ | pūrvai | kaḥ | puru'stut | kratvā | naḥ | śagdhi | rāyaḥ | bhakṣīya | te | avasaḥ | daivyasya || 10 ||
^evā evamuktaprakāreṇa stūyamānaḥ ^satyaḥ satyavān ^vaśvaḥ dhanasya ^sannāt īśvaraḥ ^vṛtraṃ vṛtranāmānamasuraṃ ^hantā hiṃsitā ^indraḥ ^pūrve manuṣyāya yajamānāya ^varivaḥ dhanaṃ ^kaḥ karoti |
^ṛtvā karmaṇā stutihetunā he ^puruhuta bahubhiryajamānaiḥ stutendra tvaṃ ^naḥ asmabhyaṃ ^rāyaḥ dhanāni ^śagdhi dehi |
nū ṣuta indra nū gṛṇāna iṣaṃ jaritre nadyoḥ na pīpeḥ |
akāri te harivo brahma navyaṃ dhiyā syāma radhyaḥ ||
na | stutaḥ | indra | nū | gṛṇānaḥ | iṣam | jaritre | nadyaḥ | na | pīperiti pīpeḥ | akāri | te | harivaḥ | brahma | navyam | dhiyā | syāma | radhyaḥ | sadāsāḥ || 11 ||
tatra ‘ yanna indraḥ’ ityekādarcaṃ prathamaṃ sūktaṃ vāmadeva- syārṣaṃ traiṣṭubhamaindram |
pṛṣṭhābhilavaṣaḍahayoḥ prathame'hani mādhyandinasavane maitrāvaruṇaśastre dvitīyamidaṃ saṃpātasūktam |
sūtritaṃ ca- ‘evā svāmindra yanna indraḥ’ ( āśva. śrau. 7. 5 ) iti ||
yanna indroṃ jujuṣe yanna vaṣṭi tanno mahānkarati śuṣmyā cit |
brahma stomaṃ maghavā somamukthā yo aśmānaṃ śavasā bibhradeti ||
yat | naḥ | indraḥ | jujuṣe | yat | ca | vaṣṭi | tat | naḥ | mahān | karati | śuṣmī | ā | cit | brahma | stomam | maghavā | somam | ukthā | yaḥ | aśmānam | śavasā | bibhrat | eti || 1 ||
^indraḥ ^naḥ asmadīyaṃ ^yat havilakṣaṇānnādikaṃ ^jujuṣe sevate ^yacca havirādikaṃ ca ^vaṣṭi kāmayate ^mahān prabhūtaḥ ^śuṣmī balavānindraḥ |
^brahma ^cit havilakṣaṇapuroḍāśādi- kamaṃ ca ^stomaṃ stotrasamūhaṃ ca ^somam abhiṣutaṃ somaṃ ca ^ukthā ukthāni śastrāṇi yeyevaṃbhūtaṃ ^tat brahmāditvaṣṭayam ^ā ^karati ākarotu svīkarotu |
1. ta-bhajeyam | 2. gha-ca-na-atha | 3. gha-na-turtīyeḍanuvāke | 4. kha-pa-pha-bha-sūktam | 5. kha-ga-gha-ca-na-bha-sa- ‘atra’ nāsti | 6. la-aśmaśabdaḥ |
vṛṣā vṛṣandhiṃ caturaśrimasyanugro bāhubhyāṃ nṛtamaḥ śacīvān |
śriye paruṣṇīmuṣamāṇa ūrṇā yasyāḥ parvāṇi saruyāya viṇye ||
vṛṣā | vṛṣandhim | catuḥ'aśrim | asyan | ugraḥ | bāhu'bhyām | nṛ'tamaḥ | śacī'vān | śriye | paruṣṇīm | uṣamāṇaḥ | ūrṇām | yasyāḥ | parvāṇi | saruyāya | viṇye || 2 ||

^vṛṣā kāmānāṃ varṣitā ^vṛṣandhiṃ meghabhedanadvāreṇa varṣaṃ kurvantaṃ ^caturaśri catasṛbhiḥ aśmibhiḥ dhārābhirupetaṃ vajraṃ ^bāhubhyāṃ hastābhyām ^asyan śatruṣu prakṣiptan ^ugraḥ udvarṇabalaḥ ^nṛtamaḥ netṛtamaḥ ^śacīvān karmavānindraḥ ^ūrṇām ācchādikāṃ ^paruṣṇīṃ parvatavatīṃ nadīṃ ^śriye āśrayaṇāryam ^uṣamāṇaḥ sevamānaḥ^1 bhavati |
yo devo devatamo jāyamāno maho vājairmahadbhiśca śubhraiḥ |
dadhāno vajraṃ bāhvoruśantaṃ dhāmamena rejayatra bhūma ||
yaḥ | devaḥ | deva'tamaḥ | jāyamānaḥ | mahaḥ | vājaiḥ | mahat'bhiḥ | ca | śubhraiḥ | dadhānaḥ | vajram | bāhvoḥ | uśantam | dhāma | mena | rejayat | pra | bhūma || 3 ||
^devaḥ dīpyamānaḥ ^devatamāḥ dātṛttamaḥ ^jāyamānaḥ upajamānaḥ ^yaḥ indraḥ ^mahaḥ mahadbhiḥ ^vājaiḥ annaiḥ ^mahadbhiḥ ^śubhraiḥ balaiḥ ^ca |
sa indraḥ ^bāhvoḥ hastayoḥ ^uśantaṃ kāmayamānaṃ ^vajraṃ ^dadhānaḥ dhārayan ^amena balena ^dyāṃ dyulokaṃ ca ^bhūma bhūlokaṃ ca ^pra ^rejayat prakampayati sma ||
ā mātrā bharati śubhryā gornutvapariṃjamabhonuvantu vātāḥ ||
viśvā | rodhāṃsi | pra'vataḥ | ca | pūrvīḥ | dyauḥ | ṛṣvāt | janimana | rejata | kṣāḥ | ā | mātrā | bharati | śubhryā | ā | goḥ | nu'vat | pari'aman | no'nuvantu | vātāḥ || 4 ||
^dyauḥ dyulokaśca ^kṣāḥ pṛthivī ca ^janiman indrasya janmani sati ^ṛṣvāt mahato'smādindrāt ^rejata arejantaḥ akampantaḥ^4 |
1. kha-ga-gha-ṇa-sevamānaḥ | 2. kha-ga-gha-ṇa-bha-‘ca’ nāsti | 3. la-unnatapradeśaḥ ucyante | 4. kha-ga-gha-ca-ṇa-na-bha-la-sa-arejata akampata |
indraḥ ˅goḥ gantuḥ sūryasya ˅mātarā mātarau mātāpitṛbhūtau dyāvāpṛthivyau ca |
˅nuvan manuṣyā iva ˅vātāḥ indreṇa preritā vāyavaśca ˅pari'man antarikṣe ˅nonuvanta śabdāyante ||
tā tū te indra mahato mahāni viśve'vitsarvaneṣu pravācyā |
yacchūra dhṛṣṇo dhṛṣatā dadhṛṣvānhī vajreṇa śavasā'vineṣīḥ ||
tā | tu | te | indra | mahataḥ | mahāni | viśveṣu | it | sarvaneṣu | pra'vācyā | yat | śūra | dhṛṣṇo iti | dhṛṣatā | dadhṛṣvān | ahim | vajreṇa | śavasā | avineṣīḥ || 5 ||
he ˅indra ˅mahataḥ prabhūtasya ˅te tvadīyāni ˅tā tāni karmāṇi ˅tu kṣipraṃ ˅mahāni mahānti bhavanti |
he ᵛindra tvaṃ ᵛyat yadā ᵛbadhumānāḥ ᵛyatreṇa badhyamānāḥ ᵛsīmanu etāḥ ᵛnadīrhisya ᵛdīrghām adhyadhikāṃ ᵛprasitiṃ bandhanam ᵛanu ᵛsyandayadhyai yathākāmaṃ syandituṃ ᵛpra ᵛmucaḥ prakarṣeṇāmocayaḥ |
he ᵛharivaḥ harivan indra ᵛannāha atraiva mocanavelāyāṃ ᵛtā ᵛu tāḥ prasiddhā eva ᵛdevīḥ devyo dyotamānāḥ ᵛsvasāraḥ nadhaḥ |
ᵛavobhiḥ tvatkṛtai rakṣaṇaiḥ ᵛte tvāṃ ᵛstvanta stāvayanti |
pipīle aṃśurmadyo na sindhurā tvā śamīṃ śaśamānasya śaktiḥ |
asmadryakṣaśuśucānasya yamyā āśune raśmi tubhyojasaṃ goḥ ||
pipīle | aṃśuḥ | madyaḥ | na | sindhuḥ | ā | tvā | śamīṃ | śaśamānasya | śaktiḥ | asmadryak | śuśucānasya | yamyāḥ | āśuḥ | na | raśmim | tuvi'ojasam | goḥ || 8 ||
he indra ᵛmaghaḥ mādayitā ᵛaṃśuḥ somaḥ ᵛpipīle apīḍhyata |
ᵛna idānīṃ ᵛsindhuḥ syandamānaḥ somaḥ ᵛtvā tvām ᵛā ᵛyamyāḥ āyacchatu |
ᵛśuśucānasya dīpyamānasya ᵛśaśamānasya stuvataḥ saṃbandhī ᵛasmadryak asmadabhimukhaṃ ᵛśamī śamanaṃ ᵛśaktiḥ stutikarma ca āyacchatu |
ᵛāśuḥ śīghragāmī yantā ᵛgoḥ ganturaśvasya ᵛtubhyojasaṃ bahubalam |
asme varṣiṣṭhā kṛṇuhi jyeṣṭhā nṛmṇāni satrā sahure sahauṃsi |
asmabhyaṃ vṛtrā suhanāni randhi jahi vardharvanuṣo martyasya ||
asme iti | varṣiṣṭhā | kṛṇuhi | jyeṣṭhā | nṛmṇāni | satrā | sahure | sahauṃsi | asmabhyam | vṛtrā | su'hanāni | randhi | jahi | vardhaḥ | vanuṣaḥ | martyasya || 9 ||
he ᵛsahure sahanaśīlendra tvaṃ ᵛsatrā sarvadā ᵛsahauṃsi śatrūnbhibhāvukāni ᵛvarṣiṣṭhā varṣiṣṭhāni pravṛddhāni ᵛjyeṣṭhā jyeṣṭhāni praśastāni ᵛnṛmṇāni balāni ᵛasme asmabhyaṃ ᵛkṛṇuhi kuru |
he indra tvam ᵛasmabhyaṃ ᵛsuhanāni śobhanavaghāni ᵛvṛtrā vṛtrāṇi śatrūn ᵛrandhi randhaya vaśaṃ naya |
kiṃca ᵛvanuṣaḥ hiṃsakasya ᵛmartyasya maraṇadharmaṇaḥ ᵛśatroḥ saṃbandhi ᵛvadhaḥ hananasādhanamāyudhaṃ ᵛjahi nāśaya ||
asmākamitsu śṛṇuhi tvamindrāsmabhyaṃ citrāṃ upa māhi vājān |
asmabhyaṃ viśvā iṣaṇaḥ puraṃdhīrasmākaṃ su maghavanbodhi godāḥ ||
asmākam | it | su | śṛṇuhi | tvam | indra | asmabhyam | citrān | upa | māhi | vājān | asmabhyam | viśvāḥ | iṣaṇaḥ | puram'dhīḥ | asmākam | su | maghavan | bodhi | go'dāḥ || 10 ||
he indra tvam asmākamita asmadīyāḥ eva stutīḥ su suṣṭhu śṛṇuhi |
tathā he indra tvaṃ citrān cayanīyāni vājān annāni asmabhyam upa māhi dehi |
kiṃca asmabhyaṃ viśvāḥ sarvāḥ puraṃdhīḥ buddhīḥ dṛṣaṇaḥ preraya |
api ca he maghavan dhanavacchindra tvaṃ asmākaṃ godāḥ gavāṃ dātā su suṣṭhu bodhi bhava ||
nū ṣuta indra nū gṛṇāna iṣe jaritre nayo' na pīpeḥ |
akāri te harivo brahma navyaṃ dhiyā syāma rathyaḥ sadāsāḥ ||
nu | stutaḥ | indra | nu | gṛṇānaḥ | iṣam | jaritre | nadyaḥ | na | pīperiti pīpeḥ | akāri | te | hari'vaḥ | brahma | navyam | dhiyā | syāma | rathyaḥ | sadāsāḥ || 11 ||
‘kathā mahām’ ityekādaśacaṃ dvitīyaṃ sūktaṃ vāmadevasyārṣaṃ traiṣṭubhamaindram |
ābhiplavike'hani daśarātre prathame'hani mādhyandinasavane maitrāvaruṇaśastre'hīnasūktasya sthānaṃ idaṃ tṛtīyaṃ saṃpātasūktam |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘kathā mahāmindraḥ pūrbhidha eka it’ (āśva. śrau. 7. 5) iti |
tathaiva pañcamāraṇyake śaunakena sūtritaṃ ca—‘kathā mahāmavṛdhatsya hoturiti saṃpāta:’ (ai. ā. 5. 2. 2) iti ||
kathā mahāmavṛdhatsya hoturyajñaṃ juṣāṇo abhi somamūrdhaḥ |
piban‌nuśāno juṣamāṇo andho vavakṣa ṛṣvaḥ śucate dhanāya ||
kathā | mahām | avṛdhat | kasya | hoturaḥ | yajñam | juṣāṇaḥ | abhi | somam | ūrdhaḥ | piban | uśānaḥ | juṣamāṇaḥ | andhaḥ | vavakṣe | ṛṣvaḥ | śucate | dhanāya || 1 ||
mahā mahāntaṃ guṇaiḥ pravṛddhamindraṃ kathā kathaṃ kena prakāreṇa avṛdhat vardhayet |
sa evendraḥ hotuḥ homaniṣpādakasya kasya yajamānasya yajñaṃ yāgaṃ juṣāṇaḥ prīyamāṇaḥ san abhi gacchediti śeṣaḥ |
kiṃca ūdhaḥ uddhatamatipravṛddhaṃ somam andhaḥ somalakṣaṇamannaṃ piban āsvādayan uśānaḥ tadevānnaṃ kāmayamānaḥ juṣamāṇaḥ sevamānaśca ṛṣvaḥ mahānindraḥ śucate pradīptāya dhanāya hiraṇyādilakṣaṇāya |
uktalakṣaṇaṃ dhanaṃ kasmai yajamānāya dātuṃ vavakṣe vahati |

1. kha-ga-ca-ṇa-asmadīyāmeva stutim | 2. kha-ga-ca-ṇa-pa-pha-bha-bahīḥ | 3. na-sa-‘tvaṃ’ nāsti | 4. kha-ga-ca-ṇa-avadharyat | 5. kha-ga-ca-ṇa-na-bha-sa-hiraṇyārtha lakṣaṇāya, ta-hiraṇyārthalakṣaṇāya | ṛ. 2-76
ko asya vīraḥ sadhamādamāpa samānaṃśa sumatibhiḥ ko asya |
kasya citraṃ cikite kadutī vṛdhe bhuvacchaśamānasya yajñauḥ ||
kaḥ | asya | vīraḥ | sadha'mādam | āpa | sam | ānaṃśa | sumati'bhiḥ | kaḥ | asya | kat | asya | citram | cikite | kat | ūtī | vṛdhe | bhuvat | śaśamānasya | yajñauḥ || 2 ||
taṃ saha somapānaṃ vā ^vīraḥ stotrāṇāmamitrāṇāṃ vā vīrayitā ^kaḥ pumān ^āpa prāpnoti |
^kat kadā vā ^asya indrasya ^citraṃ cāyanīyaṃ dhanaṃ ^cikite prajñāyate |
^kat kadā vā ^śaśa- mānasya stuvataḥ ^yajñauḥ yajurajamānasya ^vṛdhe vardhanāya ^ūtī ūrayā rakṣayā ^bhuvat bhavet ||
kuthā śṛṇoti hūyamānamindraḥ kuthā śṛṇvarvasāmasya veda |
kā asya pūrvīrūpamātayo ha kuthainamāhuḥ parpuriṃ jaritre ||
kuthā | śṛṇoti | hūyamānam | indraḥ | kuthā | śṛṇvan | avasām | asya | veda | kāḥ | asya | pūrvīḥ | upa'mātayaḥ | ha | kuthā | enam | āhuḥ | parpurim | jaritre || 3 ||
stotrāṇi ^śṛṇvan ^asya stotuḥ saṃbandhīni ^avasāṃ rakṣaṇāni ^kathā kathaṃ ca ^veda vetti |
^pūrvīḥ purā- tanāni ^asya indrasya saṃbandhīni ^upamātayaḥ dānāni ^kāḥ ^ha kānicit santīti śeṣaḥ |
tāni dānāni ^jaritre stotuḥ saṃbandhīnāṃ kāmānāṃ ^parpuriṃ pūrayitāram ^enam indraṃ ^kathā kathaṃ ca ^āhuḥ vadanti ||
kuthā sabādhaḥ śaśamāno asya naśadābhi draviṇaṃ dīdhyānaḥ |
devo bhuvabhedā ma ṛtānāṃ namau jagmuvā~ abhi yajñajoṣat ||
kuthā | sa'bādhaḥ | śaśamānaḥ | asya | naśat | abhi | draviṇam | dīdhyānaḥ | devaḥ | bhuvat | na'vedāḥ | me | ṛtānām | namaḥ | jagmuvān | abhi | yat | juṣat || 4 ||
^sabādhaḥ sapatnānāṃ pīḍāsahitaḥ ^śaśamānaḥ indraviṣayāṃ stutiṃ kurvan ^dīdhyānaḥ karmabhiḥ dīpyamāno yajamānaḥ ^asya indrasya saṃbandhi ^draviṇaṃ paścādidhanaṃ ^kathā katham ^abhi ^naśat
1. kha-ga-ṇa-bha-'bā' nāsti | 2. kha-ga-gha-ṇa-bha-stuvato'sya | 3. kha-ga-gha-ṇa- 'ba' nāsti | 4. kha-ga-ca-ṇa-bha-sa-kāni | 5. kha-ga-ṇa-bha-'ca' nāsti |
nama: habilakṣaṇamatraṃ jagṛṣmān gṛhītavānindra: yat yadā abhi jujopat mām abhiseveta¹ tadā deva: dīpyamāna indra: me madīyānām ṛtānāṃ stotrāṇāṃ navedā: atiśayena jñātā bhuvat bhavet |
kathā kadvasyā upaso vyuṣṭau devo martasya sakhyaṃ jujoṣa |
kathā kadvasya sakhyaṃ sakhibhyo ye asminkāmaṃ suyujaṃ tatsate |
kathā | kat | asyā: | upasa: | vi'uṣṭau | deva: | martasya | sakhyam | jujoṣa | kathā | kat | asya | sakhyam | sakhi'bhya: | ye | asmin | kāmam | su'yujam | tatsate ||5||
deva: dyotamāna indra: asyā upaso vyuṣṭau prabhāte martasya martyasya manuṣyasya stotu: saṃbandhi sakhyaṃ sakhikarma kathā kathaṃ kena prakāreṇa kat kadā jujoṣa seveta |

ayamindraḥ ᵛduhaṃ drohaṃ kurvantīṃ ᵛdhvarasaṃ hiṃsikām ᵛanindrāṃ indramajānantīṃ rākṣasīṃ ᵛjighāṃsan hantumicchan ᵛtigmā tigmāni pūrvameva tīkṣṇāni ᵛanīkā anīkāni āyudhāni ᵛtujase tadvadhāya ᵛtetike atyarthaṃ tīkṣṇīkaroti |
ᵛyatra yāsūpāḥ su tadupalakṣitevahaḥ su ᵛṛṇā ᵛcit ṛṇāmyapi ᵛnaḥ asmān bādhanta iti śeṣaḥ |
tāḥ ᵛupasaḥ ca ᵛugraḥ udgūrṇabalaḥ ᵛṛṇayāḥ ṛṇasya hantendraḥ |
ᵛdūre ᵛajñātāḥ ananubhūtāḥ satīḥ ᵛbabādhe apīḍayat ||
ṛtapeyanāmyekāhaṃ marutvatīyanikevalyaśastrayoḥ nividvānāt purastāt ‘ ṛtasya hi ’ ityetādike dve ṛcau krameṇa śaṃsanīye |
sūtritaṃ ca- ‘ ṛtasya hi śurudhaḥ santi pūrvīriti sūktamukhīya’ ( ā
ṛtaṃ yaimāna ṛtamid‌notyṛtasya śubhaṃsturayā u gabhyuḥ |
ṛtāya pṛthavī bahule gaṃbhīre ṛtāya dhenū parame duhāte ||
ṛtam | yaimānaḥ | ṛtam | it | vanoti | ṛtasya | śubhamḥ | tura'yāḥ | ū~ iti | gabhyuḥ | ṛtāya | pṛthavī iti | bahule iti | gaṃbhīre iti | ṛtāya | dhenū iti | parame iti | duhāte iti || 10 ||
vṛtam ṛtadevaṃ vyaimānaḥ niyacchan stutibhirvaśīkurvan stotā vṛtamin ṛtadevameva vvanoti saṃbhajate |
vṛtasya ṛtadevasya saṃbandhi vśubhamḥ balaṃ vturayāḥ tūrṇa vgabhyuḥ |
vbahule vistīrṇe vgaṃbhīre duragāhe vpṛthavī dyāvāpṛthivyau vṛtāya ṛtadevāya bhavatiḥ |
vdhenū prīṇayitryau vparame utkṛṣṭhe dyāvāpṛthivyau vṛtāya ṛtadevāyaiva vduhāte dohanaṃ kurvāte ||
nū ṣṭuta iṃdra nū gṛṇāna iṣaṃ jaritre nadyo na pīpeḥ |
akāri te harivo brahma navyaṃ dhiyā syāma radhyaḥ sadāsāḥ ||
nu | stutaḥ | indra | nu | gṛṇānaḥ | iṣam | jaritre | nadyaḥ | na | pīperiti pīpeḥ | akāri | te | hari'vaḥ | brahma | navyam | dhiyā | syāma | radhyaḥ | sadā'sāḥ || 11 ||
‘ kā sustutiḥ ’ ityekādaśacaṃ tṛtīyaṃ sūktaṃ vāmadevasyārṣamaindram |
kā sustutiḥ śarvasaḥ sunumindramarvācīnaṃ rādhasa ā vavartat |
dadirhi vīro gṛṇate vasūni sa gopatirniṣidhāṃ no janāsaḥ ||
kā | su'stutiḥ | śarvasaḥ | sunum | indram | arvācīnam | rādhase | ā | vavartat | dadiḥ | hi | vīraḥ | gṛṇate | vasūni | saḥ | go'patiḥ | niḥ'sidhām | naḥ | janāsaḥ || 1 ||
vkā kīdṛśī vsustutiḥ vśarvasaḥ sūnuṃ balasya putram |
varvācīnam asmadabhimukham vindraṃ parameśvarayuktaṃ vrādhase dhanāya asmabhyaṃ dhanaṃ dātum vā vvavartat āvartayet |

he vjanāsaḥ janā yajamānāḥ vvīraḥ vikrāntaḥ vgopatiḥ paścādidhanasya pālakaḥ vsaḥ indraḥ vniṣidhāṃ niṣedhaṇāṃ śatrūṇāṃ sambandhīni vvasūni dhanāni vgṛṇate gṛṇataḥ stotṛbhyaḥ vnaḥ asmabhyaṃ vdadirhi dātā khalu bhavati ||

sa vṛtrahatye havyaḥ sa īḍyaḥ sa suṣṭuta indraḥ satyarādhāḥ | sa yāman maghavā martyāya brahmaṇyate sunvaye varivo dhāt || 2 || saḥ | vṛtra'hatye | havyaḥ | saḥ | īḍyaḥ | saḥ | su'stutaḥ | indraḥ | satya'rādhāḥ | saḥ | yāman | ā | magha'vā | martyāya | brahmaṇyate | sunvaye | varivaḥ | dhāt || 2 ||
saḥ indraḥ vṛtrahatye vṛtrāṇāṃ śatrūṇāṃ hanye hanane nimittabhūte sati yāman yuddhe havyaḥ āhvātavyo bhavati |
saḥ indraḥ suṣṭutaḥ san satyarādhāḥ yajamānebhyo dātuṃ satyadhano bhavati |
maghavā dhanavān saḥ indraḥ brahmaṇyate stotramicchate sunvaye somaṃ sunvate martyāya manuṣyāya yajamānāya varivaḥ dhanam |

taminnaro vi hayante samīke ririkāṃsastanvaḥ kṛṇvata trām | mithyo yasyāgamabhayāso agmabharastokasya tanayasya sātau || 3 || tam | it | naraḥ | vi | hayante | sam'īke | ririkāṃsaḥ | tanvaḥ | kṛṇvata | trām | mithaḥ | yat | tyāgam | ubhayāsaḥ | agman | naraḥ | tokasya | tanayasya | sātau || 3 ||
naraḥ netāro manuṣyāḥ samīke yuddhe tamit tamevendraṃ vi hayante vividhamāhvānaṃ kurvate |
tanvaḥ svakīyāni śarīrāṇi ririkāṃsaḥ tapasā recayanto yajamānāstamevendraṃ trāṃ trātāraṃ kṛṇvata kṛṇvate kurvate |

yat yadā mithaḥ parasparaṃ saṃgatāḥ ubhayāsaḥ ubhaye yajamānāḥ stotāraśca tyāgaṃ tyāgakartāraṃ dātāramindram agman upagacchanti tadā naraḥ ubhayavidhā manuṣyāḥ tokasya putrasya tanayasya pautrasya ca sātau lābhe nimittabhūte sati tamevendraṃ trātāraṃ kurvantīti saṃbandhaḥ ||

kratuyanti kṣitayo yoga ugrāśuṣāṇāso mithyo arṇasātau | saṃ yadviśo'rvavṛtranta yuṣmā ādimema indrayante abhīke || 4 || kratu'yanti | kṣitayaḥ | yoge | ugra | āśu'ṣāṇasaḥ | mithaḥ | arṇa'sātau | sam | yat | viśaḥ | avavṛtranta | yuṣmā | āt | it | nemaṃ | indra'yante | abhīke || 4 ||
he ugra utkaṭabalendra āśuṣāṇāsaḥ vyāpnuvantaḥ kṣitayaḥ manuṣyāḥ |
arṇasātau sasyādiphalasiddhayarthamudakalābhe nimitte sati mithaḥ parasparaṃ yoge saṃbandhe sati kratuyanti kratūni karmāṇīcchanti |
yat yadā yuṣmāḥ yodhayiṣyaḥ viśaḥ prajāḥ abhīke yuddhe |
ᵥsam ᵥadhvagranta saṃvartante parasparaṃ saṃgacchante ᵥādit tadānīmeva ᵥneme kecana bhāgyavanto yodhakāḥ ᵥindrayante yuddhe indramicchanti ||
ādittu nerma indriyaṃ yaṃjanta āditpuktiḥ puroḻāśaṃ riricyāt |
āt | it | ha | nerme | indriyam | yajante | āt | it | puktiḥ | puroḻāśam | riricyāt | āt | it | somaḥ | vi | papṭhyāt | asuśvīn | āt | it | jujoṣa | vṛṣabham | yarjadhyai ||5||
ᵥādit tadānīmeva yuddhakāle ᵥneme anye yodhāḥ ᵥindriyaṃ balavantamindraṃ ᵥyajante ᵥha pūjayanti' khalu |
ᵛatha asmin divase ᵛyaḥ yajamānaḥ ᵛindrāya paramarthayuktāya devāya ᵛsomaṃ¹ sollakṣaṇamannaṃ ᵛsunavat sunuyāt abhipavaṃ kuryāt |
tathā yaḥ ᵛpaktīḥ paktavyāṃśca puroḍāśādīn ᵛpacāt pacet pacanaṃ kuryāt |
ᵛuta api ca yaḥ ᵛdhānāḥ bharjanayogyān yavān |
ᵛindraḥ ᵛmanāyoḥ stutimicchato yajamānasya ᵛucathāni stotrāṇi ᵛprati ᵛharyan pratikāmayamānaḥ san ᵛtasmin yajamāne ᵛvṛṣaṇaṃ kāmānāṃ varṣaṇa- samarthaṃ ᵛśuṣmaṃ balaṃ ᵛdadhat dhārayati ||

yadā saṃmarya vyacedaghāvā dīrgha yadājimabhyaruryadaryaḥ | arcikadṛdharṣaṇaṃ patnyacchā duroṇa ā niśitaṃ somasudbhiḥ || 8 || yadā | sa'maryam | vi | acait | ṛghāvā | dīrgham | yat | ājim | abhi | ardhyat | aryaḥ | arcikadat | vṛṣaṇam | patnīṃ | accha | duroṇe | ā | niśitam | somasudbhiḥ || 8 ||
ᵛyadā ᵛṛghāvā² śatrūṇāṃ hiṃsaka indraḥ ᵛsamarthaṃ saha martyaṃ śatruṃ ᵛrayaceta vyajñāsīt viśeṣeṇa jānīyāt |
ᵛyat yadā ᵛaryaḥ svāmīndraḥ ᵛdīrgham atyadhikam ᵛāji saṃgrāmam ᵛadhyarayata abhipaśyeta tadā tasya³ indrasya ᵛpatnī ᵛduroṇe yajñagṛhe ᵛsomasudbhiḥ somaṃ suvadbhirhavirbhiḥ ᵛniśitaṃ tīkṣṇīkṛtam |
ᵛvṛṣaṇaṃ kāmānāṃ varṣitāramindram ᵛaccha abhi ā ᵛacikadat ākrandati āhūyate ||

bhūryasā vṛtramacaratkanīyo'vikrīto akāniṣaṃ punaryan | sa bhūryasā kanīyo nārirecīdīnā dakṣā vi duhanti pra vāṇam || 9 || bhūryasā | vṛtram | acarat | kanīyaḥ | ⁴avikrītaḥ | ⁵akāniṣam | punaḥ | yan | saḥ | bhūryasā | kanīyaḥ | na | ⁶arirecīt | dīnāḥ | ⁷dakṣāḥ | vi | duhanti | pra | vāṇam || 9 ||

atra ṛgdaye saṃpradāyavidbhiḥ pūrvācāryaiḥ kecit ślokāḥ paṭhyante | te eva⁸ likhyante | ‘ahaṃ yaḥ parigṛhṇāti mūlyaṃ paṇyena bhūyasā | sa kretāraṃ punargacchanna vikrītastvayaṃ⁹ mayā’ || 1 || iti bhuvaṃ kāmayate punarmūlyasya pūraṇam | sa⁶ vikretā⁶ punarmūlyaṃ bhūyasā na praparyet || 2 || hīnaṃ na labhate varaṃ⁵ yadā vikrīta- vānpurā | yathāsamayameva syādyonaṃ punaranyathā || 3 || ayaṃ vikraya eveti samayaścet kṛto⁶ bhavet | atha mūlyārthametasyādvicāryaiva⁷ tu nirṇayaḥ⁹ || 4 || ityevaṃ samayo'kāri tadā mūlyaṃ praparyet¹⁰ | tasmādādau mayā kāryaḥ samayo'treti¹¹ cintayan¹¹ || 5 || vāmadevo vaśīkṛtya śakaṃ stotreṇa bhūyasā | vikrīṇan
9. kha-ṇa- ‘metasyāmavicāryaiva niścayaḥ; ga-ca- ‘metasyāmavicārye viniścayaḥ; na-bha-sa- ‘metasyāmavicāryaiva nirṇayaḥ |
kaścit bhūyasā bhuñjā paṇyena dravyeṇa kanīyaḥ alpataraṃ vastaṃ vasu mūlyaṃ dhanam acarat prāpnoti |
punaryan kretāraṃ punargacchan sa vikretāyamartho mayā avikrītaḥ iti bruvan akānipaṃ mūlyapūrti kāmayate ||
saḥ vikretā bhūyasā dhanena kanīyaḥ alpataraṃ mūlyaṃ nārirecīta ketuḥ sakāśācca riktīkaroti |
dīnāḥ asamarthāḥ dakṣāḥ samarthāśca vāṇaṃ vacanaṃ vi pra duhanti yathoktaṃ krayakāle tathaiva labhante ||

ka imaṃ daśābhirmamendraṃ krīṇāti dhenubhiḥ | yadā vṛtrāṇi jaṅghanadathainaṃ me punardedat || 10 || kaḥ | imam | daśābhiḥ | marma | indram | krīṇāti | dhenubhiḥ | yadā | vṛtrāṇi | jaṅghanat | atha | enam | me | punaḥ | dadat || 10 ||
mama madīyam imaṃ svabhūtam indraṃ dhenubhiḥ prāṇayitrībhiḥ daśābhiḥ daśasaṃkhyākābhiḥ stutibhiḥ kaḥ krīṇāti krayaṃ karoti |
tadānīṃ he kretāro yuṣmākaṃ madhye evamapi samayaḥ kriyate |
yadā ayamindraḥ vṛtrāṇi tvadīyān śatrūn jaṅghanat hanyāt atha anantarameva enam indraṃ me mahyaṃ punardadat punardadyāt ||

nū ṣuta indra nū gṛṇāna iṣe jaritre nadyo na pīpeḥ | akāri te harivo brahma navyaṃ dhiyā syāma rathyaḥ sadāsāḥ || 11 || nu | stutaḥ | indra | nu | gṛṇānaḥ | iṣam | jaritre | nadyaḥ | na | pīperiti pīpeḥ | akāri | te | harivaḥ | brahma | navyam | dhiyā | syāma | rathyaḥ | sadāsāḥ || 11 ||
‘ko atha’ ityṛcaṃ caturthaṃ sūktaṃ vāmadevasyārṣaṃ traiṣṭubhamaindram |
daśarātre caturthe'hani mādhyaṃdine savane stomavṛddhau maitrāvaruṇaśastre ārambhaṇīyāyā upariṣṭādidaṃ sūktamāpanīyaṃ ca |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘stome vardhamāne ko atha nyaḥ’ ( āśva. śrau. 7, 12 ) iti ||

ko adya naryo devakāma uśannindrasya sakhyaṃ jujoṣa | ko vā mahe'rvase pāryāya samiddhe agnau sutasoma īṭṭe || 1 || kaḥ | adya | naryaḥ | deva'kāmaḥ | uśan | indrasya | sakhyam | jujoṣa | kaḥ | vā | mahe | arbase | pāryāya | samiddhe | agnau | sutasomaḥ | īṭṭe || 1 ||
ᵛatra asmin divase ᵛnaryaḥ ᵛmanuṣyahitaḥ ᵛdevakāmaḥ ᵛdevānicchan ᵛuśan kāmayamānaḥ ᵛkaḥ yajamānaḥ ᵛindrasya ᵛmatsyaṃ sakhitvaṃ ᵛjujoṣa sevate |
kiṃca ᵛsutasomaḥ abhiṣutasomaḥ ᵛko ᵛvā yajamānaḥ ᵛagnau ᵛsamiddhe prajvalite sati ᵛmahaṃ mahate pravandāya ᵛpārvāya pāramahate ᵛavase tarpaṇāyā ᵛīṣṭe indraṃ stauti ||

ko nānāma varcasā somyārya manāyurvā bhavati vaste ustrāḥ | ka indrasya yujyaṃ kaḥ sakhitvaṃ ko bhrātraṃ vaṣṭi kavaye ka ūtī || 2 || kaḥ | nanāma | varcasā | somyārya | manāyuḥ | vā | bhavati | vastai | ustrāḥ | kaḥ | indrasya | yujyam | kaḥ | sakhitvam | kaḥ | bhrātram | vaṣṭi | kavaye | kaḥ | ūtī || 2 ||
ᵛkaḥ yajamānaḥ ᵛvacasā vāgrupayā stutyā ᵛsomyāya somāhyendrāya ᵛnanāma namati prahvī- bhavati |
kaḥ ᵛvā indrāya ᵛmanāyuḥ ᵛbhavati stutikāmo'smi |
kaḥ ᵛustrāḥ indreṇa daptā gāḥ ᵛvaste ācchādayati |
ᵛkaḥ ᵛindrasya ᵛyujyaṃ sāhāyyaṃ ᵛvaṣṭi icchati |
kaḥ ᵛsakhitvaṃ ᵛko ᵛbhrātraṃ bhrātṛbhāvaṃ vaṣṭi icchati |
ᵛkavaye ⁴ krāntadarśine indrāya ᵛūtī ūtaye tarpaṇāyā ᵛkaḥ |

tadarthaṃ vaḥ yuṣmān accha abhimukhyena jujupānāsaḥ sevamānāḥ somāḥ pra asthuḥ pratighnante |
uta api ca dhārayitvā ca ha vājāḥ ṛbhavaḥ viśve yūyam agriyā agrārhā agratvasaṃpādino vā abhūta bhavatha||
abhūdu vo vidhate ratnadheyamidā naro dāśuṣe martyāya |
pibata vājā ṛbhavo dade vo mahiṃ tṛtīyaṃ sarvarnaṃ madāya ||
abhūt | ū~ iti | vaḥ | vidhate | ratna'dheyam | idā | naraḥ | dāśuṣe | martyāya | pibata | vājāḥ | ṛbhavaḥ | dade | vaḥ | mahi | tṛtīyam | sarvarnam | madāya || 4 ||

he naraḥ netāra ṛbhavaḥ vaḥ yuṣmākamanugrahāt idā idānīṃ tṛtīye savane ratnadheyaṃ dātavyaṃ ranaṃ vidhate | vidhatiḥ paricaraṇakarmā | stutyā paricarate dāśuṣe havirdattavate martyāya yajamānāya mahyam abhūta bhavatu | tadarthaṃ he vājāḥ ṛbhavaḥ | etadvayaṃ vivacanāmasyāpyupalakṣaṇam | itarā- pekṣayā pratyekaṃ bahuvacanam | yūyaṃ pibata | tadarthaṃ vaḥ dade | kim | mahi mahaprabhṛtaṃ tṛtīyaṃ savanam | tatsambandhinaṃ somamityarthaḥ | kimartham | madāya harṣāya tṛptaye vā ||
ā vāṃjā yātāpaṃ na ṛbhukṣā maho naro draviṇasā gṛṇānāḥ |
ā vaḥ pītayo'bhipitve ahrāmimā astai navasveiva gamn ||
ā | vājāḥ | yāta | upa | naḥ | ṛbhukṣāḥ | mahaḥ | naraḥ | draviṇasaḥ | gṛṇānāḥ | ā | vaḥ | pītayaḥ | abhi'pitve | ahrām | imāḥ | astam | nava'sve'iva | gamn || 5 ||

he vājāḥ ṛbhukṣāḥ naraḥ netāro yūyaṃ naḥ asmān upa ā yāta | kiṃ kurvantaḥ | mahaḥ mahataḥ draviṇasaḥ dhanasya || karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhyau || mahat draviṇaṃ gṛṇānāḥ stuvantaḥ | kiṃca ahrām abhipitve abhipatane samāsau | tṛtīye savane ityarthaḥ | vaḥ yuṣmān imāḥ pītayaḥ pānāni ā gamn āgacchanti | tatra dṛṣṭāntaḥ | astam gṛhanāmaṃtat | gṛhaṃ navasvaḥ navaprasavā gāvaḥ iva || || 3 ||
ā napātaḥ śavaso yātanopemaṃ yajñaṃ narmasā hayamānāḥ |
sajoṣasaḥ sūryo yasya ca stha madhvaḥ pāta ratnadhā indravantaḥ ||
ā | napātaḥ | śavasaḥ | yātana | upa | imam | yajñam | narmasā | hayamānāḥ | sa'joṣasaḥ | sūryaḥ | yasya | ca | stha | madhvaḥ | pāta | ratna'dhāḥ | indra'vantaḥ || 6 ||
ha 'śavasaḥ 'napātaḥ balasya na pātayitārastasya putrā vā |
dvandvasya caiṣāṃ ca kaḥ prasaṅga ityucyate |
yasyendrasya saṃbandhino yūyaṃ bhavatha taducitāśvanirmāṇāt' ityabhi- prāyaḥ |
yasmādevaṃ tasmāt 'indravantaḥ prītena indreṇa tadvantaḥ 'ratnadhāḥ ramaṇīyadhanānāṃ dātāro yūyaṃ 'madhvaḥ madhuraṃ somaṃ 'piva pivata ||
sajoṣā indra varuṇena somaṃ sajoṣāḥ pāhi girvaṇo murudbhiḥ |
sa'joṣāḥ | indra | varuṇena | somam | sa'joṣāḥ | pāhi | girvaṇaḥ | murudbhiḥ | agre'pābhiḥ | ṛtu'pābhiḥ | sa'joṣāḥ | grāḥ'patnībhiḥ | ratna'dhābhiḥ | sa'joṣāḥ || 7 ||
ha 'girvaṇaḥ gīrbhirvandanīya saṃbhajanīyendra 'tvaṃ 'marudbhiḥ 'sajoṣāḥ saṃgataḥ san somaṃ 'pāhi piva ||
sajorṣo daivyena savitrā sajorṣaḥ sindhubhī ratnadhobhiḥ ||
sa'jorpasaḥ | ādityaiḥ | mādayadhvam | sa'jorpasaḥ | ṛbhavaḥ | parvatebhiḥ | sa'jorṣaḥ | daivyena | savitrā | sa'jorṣaḥ | sindhubhiḥ | ratna'dhobhiḥ || 8 ||
tathā ca 'daivyena devebhyo hitena 'savitrā 'sajopasaḥ 'ratnadhebhiḥ ratnānāṃ dātṛbhiḥ 'sindhubhiḥ syandanasvabhāvairdevaiśca 'sajopasaḥ' mādayadhvam ||

ye aśvino ye pitarā ya ūtī dhenuṃ tatakṣurbhuvo ye aśvāḥ | ye asaṃtrā ya ṛdhugrodasī ye vibhvo naraḥ svapatyāni cakruḥ || 9 || ye | aśvino | ye | pitarā | ye | ūtī | dhenum | tatakṣuḥ | ṛbhavaḥ | ye | aśvāḥ | ye | asaṃtrā | ye | ṛdhak | rodasī iti | ye | vi'bhvaḥ | naraḥ | su'apatyāni | cakruḥ ||9||
'ye ṛbhavaḥ' 'aśvinā aśvinau' 'ūtī ūtyā kriyayā rathanirmāṇarūpayā' aprīṇayan |
'ye ca' 'pitarā pitarau' 'tatakṣuḥ takṣaṇena sampādayan' 'jānāṃ santāvarttī ūyā yuvānau' cakruḥ |
'niśramaṇe gāmaraṇīta dhītibhiryā jarantā yuvaśā tākṛṇotana' (ṛ. saṃ. 1. 161. 7) ityāyuktam |
evamuktaprakāreṇa 'ye' 'vibhvaḥ' vyāptā ṛbhavaḥ 'naraḥ' 'netāraḥ' 'svapatyāni svapatanasādhanāni tatrāptisādhanāni vā karmāṇi cakruḥ |

ye gomantaṃ vājavantaṃ suvīraṃ rayiṃ dhattha vasumataṃ purukṣum | te aṃgrepā ṛbhavo mandasānā asme dhatta ye ca rātiṃ gṛṇanti || 10 || ye | go'mantam | vāja'vantam | su'vīram | rayim | dhattha | vasu'mantam | puru'kṣum | te | agre'pāḥ | ṛbhavaḥ | mandasānāḥ | asme iti | dhatta | ye | ca | rātim | gṛṇanti || 10 ||
he ṛbhavaḥ 'ye yūyaṃ 'gomantaṃ 'gomahitaṃ 'vājavantaṃ annavantaṃ 'suvīraṃ śobhanaputropetaṃ 'vasumataṃ nivāsayogyagṛhādidhanopetaṃ 'purukṣuṃ bahudhanaṃ 'atha dhārayatha mahyaṃ dātum |
he ṛbhavaḥ 'te yūyaṃ 'agrepāḥ prathamaṃ pānāraḥ 'mandamānāḥ mādyantaḥ santaḥ 'agme asmabhyaṃ 'dhatta datta rayim' |
ye ca rātiṃ gṛṇanti yajamānāḥ tebhyo'pi dhatta ||

nāpābhūta na vo'tītṛpāmāniḥśastā ṛbhavo yajñe asmin | saminreṇa mardatha saṃ marudbhiḥ saṃ rājabhī ratnadheyāya devāḥ || 11 || na | apāḥ | abhūta | na | vaḥ | atītṛpāma | aniḥśastāḥ | ṛbhavaḥ | yajñe | asmin | sam | indreṇa | mardatha | sam | marudbhiḥ | sam | rājabhī | ratna'dheyāya | devāḥ || 11 ||
3. sva- ga-ca-ṇa-na-pa-pha-bha-ye ca nare netāraḥ vibhvaḥ ṛbhavaḥ svapatyāni suprajāḥ cakruḥ te ame pāhi (agrepāḥ) ityuttaratra saṃbandhaḥ |
5. kha-na-ma-'aśvavantaṃ' nāsti; ga-ca-ṇa- pa-pha-bha-balavantam; ta-la-annavantaṃ balavantam |
vayaṃ ca ^vaḥ yuṣmān ^na ^anītṛpāma atyantaṃ tṛptāna mā karavāma |
‘ihopa yāta’ iti navacaṃ tṛtīyaṃ sūktaṃ vāmadevasyārṣaṃ traiṣṭubhamārbhavam |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘ā tvā vahantvasāvi devamihopa yātetyanuvacanam’ (āśva. śrau. 5. 5) iti |
ihopa yāta śavaso napātaḥ saudhanvanā ṛbhavo māpa bhūta |
asminhi vaḥ sarvane ratnadheyaṃ gamantvindramanu vo madāsaḥ |
iha | upa | yāta | śavasaḥ | napātaḥ | saudhanvanāḥ | ṛbhavaḥ | mā | apa | bhūta | asmin | hi | vaḥ | sarvane | ratna'dheyam | gamantu | indram | anu | vaḥ | madāsaḥ || 1 ||
he ^śavaso ^napātaḥ balasya putrāstasya na pātayitāro vā he ^saudhanvanāḥ sudhanvanaḥ putrāḥ he ^ṛbhavaḥ yūyam ^ihopa ^yāta asmin tṛtīyasavane upagacchata |
^asmin ^savane ^ratnadheyaṃ ramaṇīyadhanasya dātāram ^indramanu anusṛtya ^vaḥ yuṣmān ^madāsaḥ madakarāḥ somāḥ ^gamantu gacchantu |
sukṛtyā yatsvapasyāyā~ ca ekaṃ vicakra camasaṃ caturdhā |
ā | agn | ṛbhuṇām | iha | ratna'dheyam | abhūta | somasya | su'sutasya | pītiḥ | su'kṛtyā | yat | su'apasyāyā | ca | ekam | vi'cakra | camasam | catuḥ'dhā || 2 ||
vyakṛṇota camasaṃ caturdhā sakhe vi śikṣatyabravīt |
athaita vājā amṛtasya pantho gaṇaṃ devānāṃmabhavaḥ suhastāḥ ||
vi | akṛṇota | camasam | catuḥ'dhā | sakhe | vi | śikṣa | iti | abravīt | artha | eta | vājāḥ | amṛtasya | panthām | gaṇam | devānām | ṛbhavaḥ | su'hastāḥ || 3 ||
he ṛbhavo yūyaṃ camasaṃ caturdhā vyakṛṇota vyakuruta |
kṛtvā ca he sakhe he sakhibhūtāme vi śikṣa anugṛhāṇa somapānam ityabravīta avadata yūyam |
he vājāḥ ṛbhavaḥ suhastāḥ kuśalahastā yūyam amṛtasya amaraṇadharmakasya svargasya panthāṃ panthānam eta gacchata |
kiṃmayaḥ sivcamasa eṣa āsa yaṃ kāvyena caturśa vicakra |
athā sunudhvaṃ sarvainaṃ madāya pāta ṛbhavo madhunaḥ somyasya ||
kim'mayaḥ | sivat | camasaḥ | eṣaḥ | āsa | yam | kāvyena | caturaḥ | vi'cakra | artha | sunudhvam | sarvainam | madāya | pāta | ṛbhavaḥ | madhunaḥ | somyasya || 4 ||

kiṃmayaḥ sivat kimātmakaḥ | eṣaḥ camasaḥ | āsa | sivat praśne | yaṃ camasamekaṃ mantaṃ kāvyena kavīnāṃ medhāvināṃ saṃbandhinā karmaṇā kauśalena caturaḥ vicakra kṛtavantaḥ | atha adhunā savanam | sūyate iti savanaḥ somaḥ | taṃ madāya harṣāya sunudhvaṃ he ṛtvijaḥ | he ṛbhavaḥ yūyaṃ ca somyasya somasaṃbandhinaṃ madhunaḥ madhurasya pānaṃ pivata ||
śacyākarta pitarā yuvāṃnā śacyākarta camasaṃ devapānaṃ |
śacyā | akarta | pitarā | yuvāṃnā | śacyā | akarta | camasam | deva'pānam | śacyā | harī iti | dhanu'tarau | ataṣṭa | indra'vāhau | ṛbhavaḥ | vājaratnāḥ || 5
1. kha-ga-ca-na-pa-pha-ma-he vājāḥ suhastāḥ śobhanahastopetaḥ ṛbhavā vo yūyaṃ camasaṃ caturdhā vyakṛṇota vyakuruta |
kṛtvā ca he sakhe sakhibhūtāme viśikṣate ( na-bha-viśikṣa ) anugraheṇa somapānamiti abravīta ( na-abravīta ) avadata |
ki tadamṛta- miti devānāmindrādīnāṃ gaṇaṃ saṃghānamaita prāptāḥ ( na- prāptāḥ ' nāsti ) |
he vājiratnā: ramaṇīyasomānnā he ṛbhava: yūyaṃ śacyā karmaṇā pitarā mātāpitarau yuvānā yuvānau akarta akurata |
tathā śacyā camasaṃ devapānaṃ devapānāīma akarta caturdhā- kurutetyartha: |
śacyā harī aśvau ataṣṭa takṣaṇena saṃpāditavantaḥ |
yo va: sunotyabhipitve ahnāṃ tīvraṃ vājāsa: sarvaṃ madāya |
tasmai rayimṛbhava: sarvavīramā takṣata vṛṣaṇo mandasānā: ||
ya: | va: | sunoti | abhi'pitve | ahnām | tīvram | vājāsa: | sarvam | madāya | tasmai | rayim | ṛbhava: | sarva'vīram | ā | takṣata | vṛṣaṇa: | mandasānā: || 6 ||
he ṛbhava: vājāsa: annavantaḥ va: yuṣmabhyaṃ ya: yajamāna: ahnām abhipitve abhipatane |
taṃ madāya sunoti tasmai sarvavīraṃ bahuputropetaṃ rayiṃ dhanaṃ ha vṛṣaṇa: phalavarṣitāra: mandasānā: modamānā: mantaḥ ā takṣata saṃpādayatetyartha: ||
prāta: sutamapibo haryaśva mādhyaṃdinaṃ sarvaṃ kevalaṃ te |
samubhubhi: pibasva ratnadhebhi: sakhīryā indra cakape sukṛtyā ||
prātariti | sutam | apiba: | hari'aśva | mādhyandinam | sarvam | kevalam | te | sam | ṛbhu'bhi: | pibasva | ratna'dhebhi: | sakhīn | yān | indra | cakaṣe | su'kṛtyā ||7||
he haryaśva haritavarṇāśvopetendra prāta: prāta:savane sutam abhiputaṃ somam apiba: |
mādhyaṃdinaṃ savanaṃ kevalaṃ te paraṃ tavaiva nānyeṣām |
tṛtīyasavane ratnadhebhi: ramaṇīyadānai: ṛbhubhi: saṃ pibasva |
he indra yān ṛbhūn sukṛtyā śobhanakarmaṇā sakhīn cakaṣe akaro: ||
ye devāso abhaṃvatā sukṛtyā śyenāivedādhiṃ divi niṣeda |
te ratnaṃ dhāta śavaso napātaḥ saudhanvanā abhaṃvatāmṛtāsa: ||
ye | devāsa: | abhaṃvata | su'kṛtyā | śyenā:'iva | it | adhi | divi | ni'seda | te | ratnam | dhāta | śavasa: | napātaḥ | saudhanvanā: | abhaṃvata | amṛtāsa: || 8 ||
he ṛbhavaḥ ! ye yūyaṃ sukṛtyā śobhanakarmaṇā devāḥ abhavata abhūta |
yenāhveta śaṃsanīyagatayo gṛdhraviśeṣā iva divi dyuloke adhi niṣed abhinipaṇṇāḥ he śavasāṃ napātaḥ balavantaḥ te yūyaṃ ratnaṃ dhanaṃ dhāna prayacchata |
he saudhanvanāḥ sudhanvanḥ putrāḥ amṛtāmaḥ amṛtā devāḥ abhavata ||
tadabhavaḥ pariṣiktaṃ va etataṃ madaibhirindriyebhiḥ pibadhvam ||
yat | tṛtīyam | sarvatam | ratnadheyam | arkaṇudhvam | suapasyā | suhastāḥ | tat | ṛbhavaḥ | pari'siktam | vaḥ | etat | sam | madaibhiḥ | indriyebhiḥ | pibadhvam ||9||
he suhastāḥ śobhanahastāḥ ṛbhavaḥ ratnadheyaṃ ramaṇīyamāmadānavat yattṛtīyaṃ savanam akuṇudhvaṃ prasādhitavantaḥ |
svapasyā śobhanakarmaṇā tat etat savanaṃ savanagataṃ somadravyaṃ paripiktaṃ pariṣecanavat vaḥ yuṣmākaṃ sambandhabhiḥ madaibhiḥ mādyadbhiḥ indriyebhiḥ indriyaiḥ saṃ pibadhvam |
yadyapi vadanameva pānasādhanaṃ tathāpi cakṣuḥśrotrādīnāmapi darśanaśravaṇādinā tṛptisañjāvāna pātratvamupacaryate ||
tathā ca sūtritam-'anaśvo jātaḥ pavatau ya iti vaiśvadevam' ( āśva. śrau. 7. 7 ) iti ||
anaśvo jāno anabhīśurukthyo rathastricakraḥ pari vartate rajaḥ |
mahattadvai devasya pravācanaṃ cāmṛtabhavaḥ pṛthivīṃ yacca puṣyatha ||
anaśvaḥ | jātaḥ | anabhīśuḥ | ukthyaḥ | rathaḥ | tri'cakraḥ | pari | vartate | rajaḥ | mahat | tat | vaḥ | devasya | pra'vācanam | dhāma | ṛbhavaḥ | pṛthivīm | yat | ca | puṣyatha ||1||
he ṛbhavaḥ aśvinoḥ sambandhī yuṣmaddat rathaḥ anaśvā jātaḥ vāhanānirapekṣaḥ saṃpannaḥ |
tathā anabhīśuḥ pragraharahitaḥ ukthyaḥ stutyaḥ tricakraḥ cakratrayayuktaḥ san rajaḥ antarikṣaṃ pari vartate paribhramati |
mahat prabhūtaṃ tat rathanirmāṇasya karma vaḥ yuṣmākaṃ devatvasya devatvasya pravācanaṃ pravaktṛ praśyāpakam |
yacca yena karmaṇā yāṃ pṛthivīṃ ca puṣyatha puṣṭāṃ kurutha ||
rathaṃ ye cakruḥ suvṛttaṃ sucetaso'virharantaṃ manasaspari dhyayā |
tāṃ ū nva̭sya savanasya pītaya ā vo vājā ṛbhavo vedyāmasi ||
ratham | ye | cakruḥ | suvṛttam | sucetasaḥ | avirharantam | manasaḥ | pari | dhyayā | tān | ū~ iti | nu | asya | savanasya | pītaye | ā | vaḥ | vājāḥ | ṛbhavaḥ | vedyāmasi ||2||
vsucetasaḥ śobhanacittāḥ vye ṛbhavaḥ vsuvṛttaṃ suvartanacakram vavirharantam akuṭilaṃ vrathaṃ vmanasaḥ vdhyayā manasā dhyānenaprayatnena vnu vkṣipraṃ vcakruḥ vtān |
tāneva vasya vsavanasya vpītaye etaṃ momaṃ pātuṃ he vvājāḥ he vṛbhavaḥ vvaḥ yuṣmān vā vvedyāmasi āvedayāmaḥ ||
tadvo vājā ṛbhavaḥ supravācanaṃ deveṣu vibhavo abhavanmahitvanam |
jivrī yatsantā pitarā sanājurā punaryuvānā carathāya takṣatha ||
tat | vaḥ | vājāḥ | ṛbhavaḥ | supravācanam | deveṣu | vi'bhvaḥ | abhavat | mahi'tvanam | jivrī iti | yat | santā | pitarā | sanā'jurā | punaḥ | yuvānā | carathāya | takṣatha || 3 ||
he vvājāḥ vṛbhavaḥ he vvibhavaḥ vibhavaḥ |
vvaḥ yuṣmākaṃ vtat vmahitvanaṃ mahattvaṃ māhātmyaṃ vdeveṣu madhye vsupravācanaṃ pravācyam vabhavat |
vjivrī vṛddhau vsantā manto vsanājurā sadā jīrṇau santo vpitarā pitarau vpunaryuvānā niścataraṇau vcarathāya yathecchaṃ saṃcaraṇāya vtakṣatha saṃpāditavantaḥ ||
ekaṃ vi cakra camasaṃ caturvayaṃ niśarmaṇo gāmariṇīta dhītibhiḥ |
athā deveṣvamṛtatvamānaśa śruṣṭī vājā ṛbhavastadva ukthyam ||
ekam | vi | cakra | camasam | catuḥ'vayam | ni | carmaṇaḥ | gām | ariṇīta | dhītibhiḥ | atha | deveṣu | amṛta'tvam | ānaśa | śruṣṭī | vājāḥ | ṛbhavaḥ | tat | vaḥ | ukthyam || 4 ||
he ṛbhavaḥ vekaṃ vcamasam ekameva mantaṃ pānasādhanaṃ camasaṃ vcaturvayaṃ |
tathā vdhītibhiḥ karmabhiḥ vcarmaṇaḥ nūtanāṃ vgāṃ vniḥ variṇīta samastakuruta |
vatha ataḥ kāraṇāt vdeveṣu madhye vamṛtatva- mānaśa prāputa |
he vvājāḥ he vṛbhavaḥ vtata tādṛśaṃ vtvaḥ yuṣmākaṃ karma |

ṛbhuto rayiḥ prathamaśravastamo vājaśratāso yamajījanannaraḥ | vibhvataṣṭe vidatheṣu pravācyo yaṃ devāmo'vathā sa vicarṣaṇiḥ || 5 || ṛbhutaḥ | rayiḥ | prathamaśravaḥ'tamaḥ | vāja'śrutāsaḥ | yam | ajījanan | naraḥ | vibhva'taṣṭaḥ | vidatheṣu | pra'vācyaḥ | yam | devāmaḥ | avatha | saḥ | vi'carṣaṇiḥ || 5 ||
ˇṛbhutaḥ ṛbhūṇāṃ sakāśāta ˇprathamaśravastamaḥ prathamaṃ mukhyamatiśāyitaṃ śravaḥ? atra yaśo vā yasya dhanasya tat ˇrayiḥ dhanam |
ˇvājaśrutāmaḥ vājaiḥ agneḥ2 maharai viśyātāḥ5 ˇnaraḥ netāraḥ ṛbhavaḥ ˇyaṃ rayim ˇajījanan utpāditavantaḥ |
ˇvibhvataṣṭaḥ viśvabhirṛbhubhistaṣṭaḥ takṣaṇasaṃpannamaso'śvino ratho vā ˇvidatheṣu yajñeṣu ˇpravācyaḥ prakarṣeṇa stutyaḥ |
he ˇdevāmaḥ dyotamānāḥ yūyaṃ ˇyaṃ rathaṃ camasaṃ vā ˇavatha rakṣatha |
ˇsa ˇvicarṣaṇiḥ vividhaṃ draṣṭā bhavati draṣṭavyo bhavatītyarthaḥ ||

ma vājyarvā sa ṛṣīrvacastayā sa śūro amtā pṛtanāsu duṣṭaraḥ | sa rāyaspoṣaṃ sa suvīryaṃ dadhe yaṃ vājo vibhvā ṛbhavo yamāvipuḥ || 6 || saḥ | vājī | arvā | saḥ | ṛṣiḥ | vacastayā | saḥ | śūraḥ | astā | pṛtanāsu | dustaraḥ | saḥ | rāyaḥ | poṣam | saḥ | su'vīryam | dadhe | yam | vājaḥ | vi'bhvā | ṛbhavaḥ | yam | āvipuḥ || 6 ||

‘ uto hi vām ’ iti daśacaṃ ṣacaṃ sūktam | vāmadeva ṛṣiḥ | triṣṭup chandaḥ | dadhikrā devatā | ādyā dyāvāpṛthivyā | atrānukramaṇikā—‘ utāṃ hi daśa dādhikaṃ hi dyāvāpṛthivyādyā ’ iti | viniyogo laiṅgikaḥ ||
uto hi vāṃ dātrā santi pūrvā yā purubhyastrasadasyurnitośe |

3. kha-ga-ṇa-bha- ādyā dyāvāpṛthivyau; gha-ca-ta-pa pha-ādyāyāḥ dyāvāpṛthivyāḥ |
asyā dyāvāpṛthivyatvād atra tadvācakaśabdābhāve'pi na eva saṃbodhavye |

'yā yāni dhanāni 'purubhyaḥ atithibhyo manuṣyebhyaḥ ' 'trasadasyuḥ rājā 'nitośe nyatośata dattavān |
kṣetrāṇi sarvā bhūmīḥ sanotīti kṣetrasāḥ aśvaḥ |
'ghanaṃ hananāīm' āyudhaṃ 'dasyubhyaḥ dasyūnāṃ vadhārthaṃ ca dadathuḥ |
ṛjipyaṃ śyenaṃ pṛṣitapsuṃ āśuṃ cakrtyaṃ aryo nṛpatiṃ na śūram ||

yaṃ sīmanu pravateva dravantaṃ viśvaḥ purūmardati harṣamāṇaḥ |
